title: IMANA YADUKUNZE ISI ITARAREMWA
lyrics:
I. URUKUNDO RW'IMANA
1. IMANA YADUKUNZE ISI ITARAREMWA
1. Imana yadukunze isi itararemwa rwose,
Ijuru ritararemwa twarikumwe na Yesu.
Tugeze hano mu isi dusanga yuzuye ibyaha,
Ibyo isi bitugezeho biraduhetamisha.
R/Iyo Yesu ataza, jyewe nari mfuye (x2)
Ndamuhereza ishimwe kuko yankijije ibyaha,
Ndamukurira ubwatsi kuko yampaye ubugingo,
Yesu akiza ubugingo, Yesu akiza imibiri.
Yemwe Ntore z'Imana twabikijijwe na Yesu,
Iyo Yesu ataza twari kuzagana he?
Iyo adatuma Branham twari kuzagana he?
2. Murebe urwo rukundo yaje kudukiza ibyaha,
Yaje kutubohora kandi yitwaje n'Ijambo;
Ati "abarushye mwese n'abarembejwe n'ibyaha,
Nimuze mbaruhure, mwakire Umwuka n'Ijambo."
3. None iryo Jambo yaribibye mu mutima wawe,
Reka rikubohore kandi ryere imbuto nyinshi,
Ureke kurirwanya nubwo rivugwa n'abantu,
Kuko uhereye kera Umwuka Akoresha abantu.
4. Uwo Mwami Yesu sinabona uko mushima,
Kuko yanyitangiye akanambwa ku bwanjye,
Amena amaraso ye kugirango andage Ubwami,
Iyo Yesu ataza nari kuzaganahe?
5. Yampaye ibyishimo anyereka urukundo,
Mbona n'umunezero ntari nakabona mu isi,
Amvura indwara zose ankuraho imitwaro,
Iyo Yesu ataza nari kuzaganahe?
6. None mugenzi wanjye ngwino wisangire Yesu,
Agukize umuriro uzatwika isi yose,
Uruhuke uburetwa, uvurwe imvune zose,
Wibonere amahirwe kandi uzashire agahinda.

title: UMVA, WA JURU WE
lyrics:
2. UMVA, WA JURU WE
1. Umva wa juru we n'ibikurimo byose,
Uburyo Yesu agira neza,
Nawe wa si y'abantu n'inyamaswa zose,
Tumuhimbaze ni mwiza.
R/Ni Umugwaneza, ni Umugwaneza (x3)
Umwami Imana yanjye,
Ni Umugwaneza, Haleluya!
Oh, nzamuhimbaza iteka.
2. Turacumura, dutakaza byose,
Mu bugwaneza bwe ariyemeza,
Kuducungura ahimbazwe.
3. Nk'Umwana w'Intama, yaje hano mu isi,
Amena amaraso ngo aducungure,
Kuva icyo gihe twavuga tuti:
"Wa rupfu we, waraneshejwe!"
4. Kimwe n'ikizu, araturinda,
Azi ibyo dukena, n'abari mu kaga,
Kandi buri munsi arangurura ati:
"Nimuhumure, turi kumwe!"
5. Kandi nk'uko inkoko igota imishwi yayo,
Yesu aratugota kandi atwitaho;
Inkuba n'imiyaga byaturuka he,
Turi mu mahoro asesuye.
6. Ndahimbaza, nkaramya Umwami Yesu
Ku byo adahwema kunkorera byose;
Sinashobora kubara imigisha,
Ndumva nshaka kumuramya.

title: NARI KUBA UWANDE
lyrics:
3. NARI KUBA UWANDE
1. Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Mba mboshywe n'ibyaha,
Ndi umunyamibabaro.
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Ubuzima bwanjye bwari kuba amaganya.
R/Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari kuba nk'ubwato nta musare,
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Ubugingo bwanjye bwari kuba mubapfuye.
2. Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari kuba imbohe y'amadini yiyunze,
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari bwizere intekerezo z'abantu.
3. Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Mba narayobejwe n'isi ya none,
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari butwarwe n'ibiriho by'isi.
4. Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari kubaho nta byiringiro mfite,
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Mba nararengewe, mba narashobewe.
5. Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari kuba uwande iyo Eliya ataza,
Nari kuba uwande iyo ntagira Yesu,
Nari kwakira ikimenyetso cy'inyamaswa.

title: MANA URI MWIZA
lyrics:
4. MANA URI MWIZA
1. Mana uri mwiza unyitaho rwose,
Untekerezaho ugakiranuka,
Ngwino uyisange uko umeze kose,
Irashaka kugufasha mu makuba.
R/Imana izi ibikuremereye byose,
Bikubangamiye bikubuza amahoro,
Ibyifuzo byawe byose Imana irabizi,
Hamwe n'Imana byose birashoboka.
2. Ibaho iteka ishobora byose,
Ngwino uyisenge iragusubiza,
Mu icuraburindi, kwiheba n'agahinda,
Menya yuko mu ijuru utibagiranye.
3. Mana ujye umfasha, yobora intambwe zanjye,
Mu rugendo rwanjye ngandukire Imana,
Ntugire ubwoba, Yesu akwitayeho,
Arasohoza ibyo yasezeranije.

title: KU MABABA Y'INUMA
lyrics:
5. KU MABABA Y'INUMA
1. Nowa yari mu nkuge, yamaze iminsi myinshi,
Yashakishije ikirwa, mu buryo bwinshi,
Yahuye n'ingorane, ntizavuye mu ijuru,
Imuha ikimenyetso ku mababa y'inuma.
R/Ku mababa y'inuma yera,
Imana iduha urukundo,
Ikimenyetso cyo mu Ijuru,
Ku mababa y'inuma.
2. Yesu Mukiza wacu, yavukiye mu isi,
Mu ruhongore rw'inka, mu muvure w'inka,
Yaranzwe hano mu isi, ntiyanzwe no mu Ijuru,
Imuha ikimenyetso, ku mababa y'inuma.
3. Narababaye cyane, mu buryo bwinshi,
Nagumye ntabaza ijoro n'umunsi,
Ukwizera kwanjye, ntiyakwirengagije,
Yampaye ikimenyetso, ku mababa y'inuma.

title: NDIRIMBA IYI NDIRIMBO
lyrics:
6. NDIRIMBA IYI NDIRIMBO
1. Nshimwe ndirimba ndanezerewe,
Kubwo guhimbaza Umwami wanjye,
We wasize ubwiza bwe mu Ijuru,
Kubwo kunkiza uburetwa bw'icyaha.
R/Mwami wanjye Yesu, ushimwe cyane,
Izina ryawe rihimbazwe iteka,
Nguhaye ubugingo bwanjye,
Rinda, genzura intambwe zanjye, oh Yesu,
Ndakwihaye wese.
2. Urukundo rwe rusumba byose,
Mu Maraso ye narabohowe,
Kandi nakuwe mu mwijima pe,
Ntawundi nshima ni Yesu mukundwa.
3. Ndi n'umugenzi hano mu isi,
Nahisemo Yesu rumuri rwanjye,
No kuyoborwa ngana Siyoni,
Muri urwo rurembo, umurwa w'iteka.

title: YABAMBWE K'UMUSARABA
lyrics:
7. YABAMBWE K'UMUSARABA
1. Mfite Umukiza mwiza cyane,
Yambereye Umucunguzi,
Yatanze ubugingo bwe bwose,
Amfira k'Umusaraba.
R/Yabambwe k'Umusaraba,
Yabambwe k'Umusaraba,
Yikoreye ibyaha, arambohora,
Yabambwe k'Umusaraba.
2. Yasize ubwiza bwe mu Ijuru,
Kugira ngo aducungure,
Hano ku isi yaciye bugufi,
Atubohoza Amaraso.
3. Yarababajwe arinjye azira,
Yajanjaguwe ku bwanjye,
Yishyizeho indwara zanjye zose,
Arapfa ngo njye nezerwe.

title: NYUZUZA URUKUNDO
lyrics:
8. NYUZUZA URUKUNDO
1. Reka Mwami nyure mu nzira wanyuzemo,
Inzira inyobora mu Ijuru,
Utanga umunezero kubatereranwe,
Nyuzuza urukundo Mwami.
R/Nyuzuza urukundo Mwami, uko ngendana n'inuma,
Reka ngende buri munsi, n'indirimbo n'ibyishimo,
Nyuzuza urukundo rwawe.
2. Ngume iruhande rwawe, Yesu unyobora,
We kundekera mu mwijima;
Undinde uburakari,
Umvure ubugingo bwanjye,
Nyuzuza urukundo Mwami.
3. Aho bukera ni iherezo ry'urugendo,
Iherezo ry'urugendo,
Nzatura mu Ijuru,
Ndirimbe, Mwami shimwa,
Nyuzuza urukundo Mwami.

title: UMWAMI ARANKUNDA
lyrics:
9. UMWAMI ARANKUNDA
1. Umwami arankunda, bihebuje,
Umwami arankunda, ni urukundo.
R/Nzabivuga iteka,
Yesu arankunda,
Yesu arankunda,
Ni urukundo.
2. Mu mibabaro, mu busharire,
Iyo ndira njyewe mbabaye,
Nzabivuga iteka.
3. Iyo mbabaye, nta byiringiro,
Iyo mbabaye, bikomeye,
Nzabivuga iteka.
4. Mu gahinda kenshi, ndemerewe,
Naniwe cyane, nazimiye,
Nzabivuga iteka.
5. Mu buntu bwe, yaranyitangiye,
Ancunguza ayo Maraso ye,
Nzabivuga iteka.
6. I Kaluvari kure y'Ijuru,
Yaretswe rwose,
Araza amena Amaraso ye,
Nzabivuga iteka.
7. Icyubahiro kibe icyawe,
Umwana w'Intama ahimbazwe,
Nzabivuga iteka.

title: REKA NGUSHIME
lyrics:
10. REKA NGUSHIME
1. Umwami Yesu ni ubwugamo bwanjye,
Yampaye amahoro mu mutima,
Ibimbabaza abinkuraho byose,
Nemeye nanjye kujya muhimbaza.
R/Reka ngushime yewe Mwami wanjye,
Ibyo wakoze birakomeye,
Kuba warankuye mu madini,
Ukanshyira mu Itorero ryawe.
2. Narakubonye yewe Mana yanjye,
Mu bihe bibi bikomeye,
Narinzi ko ibyanjye birangiye,
Ineza yawe Mana irantabara.
3. Amagambo yawe Mana aranezeza,
Agaragaza kamere yawe,
Ibyo waremye nabyo hano ku isi,
Bigaragaza gukomera kwawe.
4. Uguhinyura ni nde Mana yanjye?
Nahanga amaso k'Umusaraba,
Wemeye gupfa ako kageni,
Kugirango Mwami ukize umuntu.

title: NZAMUREBA
lyrics:
11. NZAMUREBA
1. Yesu yaje hano muri iyi si,
Aje ku mugambi w'Ijuru,
Imana nzima yera yihindura umuntu,
Kugirango twe ducungurwe.
R/Nzamureba Yesu, nzamureba,
Nzamureba maze amenye,
Nzamureba Yesu, nzamureba,
Nzanezezwa n'agakiza ke.
2. Imana yaje kubohora abantu bayo,
Ariko bo ntibamumenya,
Baramufata, baramubamba, baramwica,
Mbabazwa n'urupfu yapfuye.
3. Yesu azagaruka hano muri iyi si,
Aje gucungura Umugeni we,
Uwo yakoye Amaraso ye y'igiciro,
Bajye kwibanira mu Ijuru.
4. Ningera mu Ijuru ho ku Mana yacu,
Tuzabona abacu twabuze,
Petero, Branham ndetse na Yohana,
Abo bose tuzababona.

title: KU MUSOZI WA SANISETI
lyrics:
II. UMUHANUZI W'IGIHE CY'IMPERUKA
12. KU MUSOZI WA SANISETI
R/Ku musozi wa Saniseti,
Ku mugoroba izuba rirenga,
Niho habonetse inkingi nkiyabonekeye Sawuli,
William Branham (×2)
Inkingi y'umuriro iramugota.
1. Reba hejuru ku mutwe wiwe,
Urabona inkingi y'umuriro,
Bene Data bakundwa, yihishuriwe intamenyekana,
Ibi byose yabihishe abanyabwenge (×2)
Ngo ubwami bw'Imana bwamamare.
2. Igihe yatumirwaga mu nama,
Abapasitori bize bateranye,
Bari bazi yuko Branham
Akorwa n'isoni, izuba rirenga,
Umwuka w'Imana amubonye,
Amukomeza mu byo avuga.
Ati "wigira ubwoba Branham" (×2)
"Izi saha turi kumwe."
3. Umwuka Wera umaze kwigaragaza,
Branham yahawe ubutumwa,
Ati "genda uburire abatuye isi,
Bari mu bikorwa by'umwijima,
Abemera kwihana babatizwe,
Babatizwe mu Izina ry'Umwami Yesu."
4. None Mwene Data wumva ubu butumwa,
Isaha zawe zaba ari izi zigeze,
Ngo wegere Umwami Yesu akubabarire,
Ibicumuro byawe byose wakoze,
Ubu ni igihe cyo gutanga imbabazi,
Ari ku bicu ubu ni wowe ategereje.

title: IGIHE CYA NYUMA
lyrics:
13. IGIHE CYA NYUMA
1. Ndabona ibihe biruhije by'isi,
Abantu bashaka ibyo uyu mubiri,
Bashaka iby'isi bibahumuriza,
Ntibazi ko byose ari ubusa, ni iherezo.
R/Niherezo, riregereje,
Umugeni ari kwihuriza hamwe,
Mu mahanga biranze,
Isiraheri irageruwe,
Ni iherezo Umuhanuzi yavuzeho.
2. Mbese iki nicyo gihe Umuhanuzi yavuze?
Marayika yaje arangurura,
Ijwi rye ryanyeganyeje imisozi,
Ijwi rikomeye ryeruye ati "nta gihe."
3. Mbese witaye ku butumwa bw'igihe?
Mbese usoma Malaki kane,
Ibyahishuwe icumi,
Luka cumi na karindwi?
Ubu butumwa buvugaho ni iherezo.

title: UKO IBISEKURU
lyrics:
14. UKO IBISEKURU
R/Uko ibisekuru byagiye bisimburana,
Niko byagiye bigira Intumwa zabyo,
Ni kuki n'iki gisekuruza cyacu,
Nacyo kitaba kidafite Intumwa yacyo?
1. Ku musozi mwiza, witwa Sinayi,
Niho Mose yaganiriye n'Imana,
Maze imuha amategeko yayo,
Kuyashyikiriza Abisirayeli.
2. Umwuka Wera yahanuriye Amatorero,
Ashyiraho n'Intumwa hamwe n'Abahanuzi,
Ngo babwirize banaburire amatorero,
Umwuka Wera nawe abafashe kwisuzuma,
Abakoze ibyaha nabo babashe kubyihana,
Umwuka Wera abinjize ijya mu Ijuru.
3. Ibyahishuwe Intumwa Yohana,
Umutwe wa kabiri kugera kuwa gatatu,
Hatwereka intondeke zigize amatorero,
Aribyo bisekuru by'abemera Yesu.
Malaki gatatu nawe akatubwira ati:
"Dore nzaboherereza Umuhanuzi Eliya."
4. Abefeso bigishijwe na Pawulo,
Simiruna yigishijwe na Irene,
Perugamu aribwo Bwami bwa satani,
Irwanya amatorero yavugaga Yesu.
Martini umwigisha wiki gisekuru,
Niwe wari ijwi ry'igisekuru cyaryo.
5. Umwuka Wera arongera arigaragaza,
Tuwatira yigishwa na Kolomba,
Sarudi nayo yigishwa na Luteli,
Akaba umupadiri ufite Umwuka Wera,
Awukoresheje uhembura amatorero.
Firaderifiya Wesileyi araza,
Lawodokiya nayo ntiyapfukiranwa,
Umwuka Wera yohereza Branham.

title: BRANHAM AHAGAZE MU RUZI RWA OHIO
lyrics:
15. BRANHAM AHAGAZE MU RUZI RWA OHIO
R/Branham ahagaze mu ruzi rwa Ohio,
Ari kubatiza umuntu wa cumi na karindwi,
Haza Ijwi rirangurura riri kumubwira riti:
"Natumye Yohana kunteguriza kuza kwa mbere,
Nawe genda untegurize kugaruka kwa kabiri."
1. Branham igihe amaze kumva iryo jwi,
Inkingi y'Umuriro uwo mwanya imwambika imbaraga,
Imujyana mu bihugu byinshi,
Kuhavuga ubutumwa, ahanurira abantu benshi,
Kandi asengera abarwayi.
2. Mu mwaka w'igihumbi na magana cyenda, mirongo itanu,
Hari mukwezi kwa mbere,
Branham aratumirwa mu giterane gikomeye,
Cyabereye I Houston.
Mu bandi bapasiteri b'amadini anyuranye,
Ari ku gicaniro babona inkingi y'Umuriro,
Yageze ku mutwe wiwe, bose baratungurwa,
Bababazwa n'ibibaye k'umuntu bahoze bapinga.
3. Ako kanya abapasiteri bize Tewolojiya,
Bitotombeye rimwe bose bati "ibibaye n'ibiki,
K'umuntu utagira ishuri, ntagire n'amafaranga,
Dusebeye imbere yiwe,
Reka twange ubutumwa bwe."
4. Abanyamakuru nabo ubwabo,
Birebera ibibaye bati "ibi bintu ntibisanzwe,
Kandi sibyo gucecekwa,"
Babikwiza mu binyamakuru byinshi binyuranye.
Niba wagira ngo ndabeshya, andika
Duburove eshatu (www). Branham.doticome
Niho ubonera Branham hamwe n'ubutumwa bwe.

title: MENYA IGIHE CYAWE
lyrics:
16. MENYA IGIHE CYAWE
R/Menya igihe cyawe, n'Ubutumwa bwacyo,
Ibyavuzwe birasohoye, nawe uhitemo.
1. Ibuka Nowa, igihe yabaje inkuge,
Abamubonaga abenshi baramuseka,
Umwuzure uje, abantu bararohama.
2. No mugihe cyacu dufite Umuhanuzi ubu,
Eliya wavuzwe n'Umuhanuzi mukuru,
Malaki gatatu niho hatubwira hati:
"Dore nzaboherereza Umuhanuzi Eliya."
3. Torero ry'Imana murwane izo ntambara,
Dore isezerano rigiye gusohora,
Ngo Umukwe wavuzwe abone Umugeni we,
Nta yindi nteguza, wizere ubu butumwa,
Humbe 'geni wa Kristo w'igihe cy'imperuka.
4. Igihe cyo kuza kwa Yesu,
Yoherereje Yohana kumuteguriza,
Ni gihe cyo kuza kwe kwa kabiri,
Yoherereje Branham.

title: IJWI RY'UMUHANUZI
lyrics:
17. IJWI RY'UMUHANUZI
R/Tega amatwi ijwi ry'Umuhanuzi,
William Marrion Branham, wowe Gisekuru cy'i Lawodokiya,
Aguhe umuti wo gusiga ku maso.
1. Lawodokiya wowe wiyita umukire,
Ati "ndi umutunzi kandi ndatunganiwe,"
Mu byahishuriwe Intumwa Yohana yavuze
Yuko ari wowe mutindi ukaba umukene,
Kandi ukaba n'impumyi ndetse na nubu,
Wambaye ubusa.
2. Ibyahishuriwe Intumwa Yohana ibice bitatu,
Cumi n'umunani hakugira inama yo kumuguraho,
Izahabu imwe yatunganirijwe mu ruganda.
3. Yewe muntu w'i Lawodokiya, gura izahabu nibwo
Witwa umutunzi n'imyenda yera wambike ubwambure
Bwawe, kuko abo nkunda bose ndabacyaha.

title: BRANHAM UYU YABAYEHO
lyrics:
18. BRANHAM UYU YABAYEHO
R/Branham uyu yabayeho,
Ku itariki esheshatu z'ukwezi kwa Kane,
Igihumbi magana cyenda n'icyenda,
Avukira I Kentuki muri Amerika.
1. Igitangaza cya mbere cyabaye avuka,
Mu rugo iwabo habaye umucyo udasanzwe,
Inkingi y'umuriro itangira kumwihishurira,
Ko izamumurikira mu mibereho yiwe.
2. Mu kwezi kwa cyenda, ho muri uyu mwaka,
Igihumbi magana cyenda na cumi na gatandatu,
Niho yavuye ku iriba avuye kuvoma,
Ahita ahura na Marayika w'Imana.
3. Marayika umva inshingano yubwe yamuhaye ati:
"Branham, ntuzanywe inzoga n'itabi,
Kandi uzirinde ikibi icyo aricyo cyose,
Kuko nukura nzakugira igikoresho."
4. Marayika w'Imana akimuvugisha,
Branham yahise yuzura ubwoba,
Arirukanka agenda aririra hose,
Mama wiwe ahita amubaza icyo abaye.
5. Branham yamusubizanije ubwoba,
N'amarira menshi ndetse n'agahinda,
Ati "naringeze mu nzira mva kuvoma,
Haza umuyaga numva umuntu arampamagaye.
Nawe wumve ukuntu yahise ambwira ati:
'Branham, ntuzanywe inzoga n'itabi,
Kandi uzirinde ikibi icyo aricyo cyose,
Kuko nukura nzakugira igikoresho.'"
6. Mwene Data nawe tega amatwi yawe,
Umuhamagaro wawe nugera wumve,
Ufite ijambo nawe wavuzweho uvuka,
Hora uri maso, nuhamagarwa witabe.

title: NIKI UTUMVA
lyrics:
19. NIKI UTUMVA
1. Nk'uko yatumye Yohana
Mu kuza kwe kwa mbere,
Na Branham niko byamugendekeye,
Guteguriza Yesu kuza kwa Kabiri.
R/Niki, niki utumva Mwene Data?
Wumva ubu Butumwa,
Nta kindi gihe gisigaye,
Ngo uzabona undi ukuburira.
2. Mu gihe cy'umugoroba,
Branham ntiyaryamye,
Yabonye inkingi y'Umuriro,
Imanuka imwegera,
Ngo ahishurirwe iby'ubwiru,
Ubutumwa bwiza bugere ku isi yose.
3. Iri tabaza wabonye, ry'ibitereko birindwi,
Ni ryo amatorero arindwi,
Umwuka Wera wabwiye
Yuko uzakuramo Umugeni,
Nawe tangira umese ikanzu.
4. Mu butumwa bw'umugoroba,
Nicyo cya gihe cy'ubuhanga,
Nicyo cya gihe cy'ubushishozi,
Nk'uko Yohana abitubwira,
"Abafite amatwi nibumve,"
Kuko nta yindi nteguza hanyuma.
5. Mu isenywa ry'i Babuloni, bohererejwe
Umuhanuzi binangira imitima, bicwa n'ubwibone bwabo,
Uburaya n'ubusinzi, nibyo byatumye barimbuka.
6. Mu butumwa bwa Branham,
Yahawe no gukiza indwara,
Ibihumbi mirongo itatu na bitanu,
Birakira, anasengera abapfuye.
7. Bamwe muribo barazuka,
Harimo umwana w'umuhungu,
Wo mu gihugu cya Finilande,
Yanakijije kanseri umukobwa wari waranyunyutse.

title: IBYAHANUWE N'ABAHANUZI
lyrics:
20. IBYAHANUWE N'ABAHANUZI
1. Ibyahanuwe n'Abahanuzi,
Mwibuke ko byose bisohoye,
Mureke gukerensa iri Jambo,
Mudahinduka nka muka Loti.
2. Ubu Butumwa n'ubwanyu bakundwa,
Mwabuteguriwe n'Umwuka Wera,
Mwibuke Ijambo yatumye Malaki
Ati "nzaboherereza Umuhanuzi."
3. Ku musozi mwiza Saniseti,
Niho havuye ubu butumwa bwiza,
Bwahanuwe n'Abahanuzi kera,
None busohoye mu gihe cyacu.
4. Bene Data mwirinde igihe cyose,
Mukore ibyiza kandi igihe cyose,
Umwami Yesu azaza nk'umujura,
Ariyo mpamvu ubu yaduteguye.

title: NIKI GITUMA USHIDIKANYA
lyrics:
21. NIKI GITUMA USHIDIKANYA
R/Ni iki gituma ushidikanya ibitangaza by'Imana?
Biracyakorwa Jefersonville wo muri Indiana,
Inkingi y'umuriro iramanuka ati:
"Branham, ko natumye Yohana kunteguriza kuza kwanje kwa mbere,
Nawe niko ngutumye kunteguriza ukugaruka kwanjye kwa kabiri."
1. Umwaka w'igihumbi magana cyenda makumyabiri na karindwi,
Branham afite imyaka cumi n'umunani,
Marayika w'Imana aramubonekera,
Amuteguza gutangira umurimo w'Imana.
2. Branham yahawe buno butumwa abwakirana
Ituza adashidikanya, abukwiza isi yose,
Ngo ababwemera bihane babatizwe mu Izina rya Yesu,
Bababarirwe ibyaha byabo bakoze,
Ukuzamurwa kwacu kuri bugufi.
3. Kera mwibuke ko tutari ubwoko namba,
None ubu turabarwa mu bwoko bw'Imana,
Kera ntitwari twakababarirwa,
None twacunguwe n'Amaraso ya Yesu.
4. Inkingi y'Umuriro ku musozi Saniseti,
Marayika w'Imana yaramanutse,
Ngo ibyari ubwiru byose bisobanuke,
Agakiza gasubire muri Isirayeli.

title: IBYIZA BYO MURI UBU BUTUMWA
lyrics:
22. IBYIZA BYO MURI UBU BUTUMWA
1. Ibyiza byo muri ubu butumwa byamaze kuducengera,
Tubizaniwe na Yesu, 'Umuhanuzi William Marrion Branham,
Twari turuhiye mu madini adukuzayo ineza ye,
None ubu twahindutse umwe, niyo mpamvu tumwirata.
R/Ni wowe dushyize imbere, Mwami w'amahanga yose,
Naho twaba mu bukene, tuzagumya kukwirata.
2. Sinzigera nibagirwa uko wabanye
N'Umuhanuzi William Marrion Branham,
Inkingi y'Umuriro iramugota,
Nibuka nimibanire ya Yosuwa na Kalebu,
Na Elisa na Eliya, na Pawulo na Timoteyo.
Umurimo wawe Mana nukore,
Abawukurikije badasigana
Mu rugendo, ukabarangaza imbere.
3. Intwari zatubanjirije zomatanye nawe iteka,
Wazirutiye imirima ndetse n'amashyo mu biraro,
Niyo mpamvu zakwirase ndetse na bugingo,
N'ubu zirase imbaraga zawe Mana, nanjye ndagushimiye.
Naho imirima yarumba n'amashyo akanshiraho,
Ntacyambuza kukwirata kuko wambereye byose.

title: UKO ABISIRAYELI BASOHOTSE
lyrics:
III. GUSOHOKA
23. UKO ABISIRAYELI BASOHOTSE
1. Uko Abisirayeli basohotse,
Bava mu Egiputa kwa Farawo,
Niko natwe turi gusohoka,
Tuva mu madini yose.
R/Niba utagize umwete wo gusohoka,
Ntabwo uzagera muri Yerusalemu siya,
Yateguriwe Umugeni wa Yesu,
Ubwo azaza kutujyana.
2. Twamaze kubona Umuhanuzi,
Niwe watuzaniye ubutumwa,
Butuyobora muri uru rugendo,
Dufite rujya mu Ijuru.
3. Icyo gihugu kirakomeye,
Nta muntu uzapfa kwinjira gusa,
Keretse uwizeye ubu rumuri,
Rw'igihe cy'umugoroba.

title: MUSOHOKE BABULONI
lyrics:
24. MUSOHOKE BABULONI
R/Bene Data musohoke Babuloni,
Mureke ubusinzi, mureke ubusambanyi,
Hamwe n'izindi ngeso,
Uwiteka yanga, urunuka,
Ibi nibyo byaha byarimbuye Babuloni.
1. Bene Data, musohoke Babuloni,
Muve mu madini yabagize imbata zayo,
Yo atigeze amenya yuko Yesu ari Imana,
Kugeza na nubu amadini ari kumurwanya.
2. Bene Data, musohoke Babuloni,
Muve mu madini yabagize imbata zayo,
Mwibuke ko Kayafa yari umutambyi mukuru,
Niwe watumye Yesu bamujyana kwa Pilato.
3. Bene Data, musohoke Babuloni,
Muve mu madini yabagize imbata zayo,
Yigisha Tewolojiya, agahisha Ijambo ry'Imana,
Ijambo ry'ukuri rigahinduka iyobera.
4. Bene Data, musohoke Babuloni,
Yesu niwe nzira, niwe kuri, n'ubugingo,
Yabihamirije Yohana cumi na kane,
Reba ku murongo wa gatandatu uhasome.

title: KU MABABA Y'IKIZU
lyrics:
25. KU MABABA Y'IKIZU
1. Nahoze mbundikiwe munsi y'amababa y'inkoko,
Nyuma namenye ko ntari mu muryango w'izo nkoko,
Ijwi ryampamagaye ntiryari ijwi ry'inkoko,
Ryari ijwi ry'Ikizu rya Data Elishadai.
R/Guruka ugere kure yewe mwana w'Ikizu (x2),
Reka ibyo byaha n'imiruho, iyo ni kamere y'inkoko,
Kandi bene abo ntibazaraganwa Ijuru n'Ibizu.
2. Ijwi ryampamagaye ryantandukanije n'inkoko,
Ariyo Madini yo muri iyi si icuze umwijima,
Amadini y'iki gihe arimo kubamba Ijambo,
Kuko kamere yayo ari kamere y'inkoko.
3. Iyo Ikizu gishaje cyegera urutare,
Gikubita amababa yacyo kuri urwo rutare,
Kikicara gitegereje uwakigaburira,
Ibibazo byawe nawe ubihe Kristo.
4. Niba uri umwana w'Ikizu, gira kamere nk'iyacyo,
Ibigeragezo byawe ubishyire kuri Kristo,
Nk'uko Ikizu cyarika icyari ku rutare,
Niko n'Umukristo yubaka ku guhishurirwa.
5. Nari igi ryaburiye mu cyari cy'izo nkoko,
Nyuma nkurira muri zo, ariko njye ntari inkoko,
Numva ijwi ryumvikana rimbwira ngo "nguruke,"
Mve mu mibereho yazo, menye ko njye ndi Ikizu.

title: KUTAMENYA IYO UVA
lyrics:
26. KUTAMENYA IYO UVA
R/Kutamenya iyo uva n'intambara ikomeye,
Ntunamenye iyo ujya, nawe ubitekereze,
Ubone gushidikanya kuri ubu butumwa,
Ntabwo Imana Yacu yaba ari Umubeshyi.
1. Yewe Mwene Data wumva buno butumwa,
Soma muri Malaki ibice byaho bitatu,
Umurongo wa makumyabiri na gatatu,
Ugeze kuwa makumyabiri na kane.
2. Umva isezerano Eliya yateguriwe,
Niwe uzasanganya imitima y'abana na ba Se,
Niwe uzagarura ukwizera kw'Intumwa,
Zose uko zingana, ukuyemo uwitwa Yuda.
3. Mu mirimo y'Intumwa habagamo ukwizera,
Habagamo urukundo n'ubudahemuka,
Zogezaga Yesu no ku bandi batamuzi,
Ngo ubutumwa bw'Ubwami bubone kubanza kuza.
4. Yohana Umubatiza nawe yaje ari integuza,
Yabwiye rubanda yuko hari ugiye kuza,
Yuko atapfundura udushumi tw'inkweto ziwe,
Haboneka umucyo, Umwami Yesu araza,
Indirabo Umugeni w'Imana.
5. Tega amatwi Torero ry'i Lawodokiya,
Wumve isezerano nawe wateguriwe,
Ni wowe wabwiwe muri iki gisekuru,
Yuko Eliya ariwe ugomba kubanza kuza.
6. Ku musozi Saniseti havuye igitangaza,
Inkingi y'umuriro ihita igota Branham,
Ngo isezerano ryacu ribone gusohora,
Ahubwo hahirwa uwizera ubutumwa.

title: INKUGE Y'IGIHE CY'UMUGOROBA
lyrics:
27. INKUGE Y'IGIHE CY'UMUGOROBA
1. Inkuge y'igihe cy'umugoroba,
Nta handi wayibona uretse mu Ijambo,
Ijambo ry'Imana, Bibiliya Yera,
Itubere umuyobozi.
R/Ufite inzira ebyiri imbere yawe,
Imwe y'Ubugingo, indi ni urupfu,
Ihitiremo neza ube Umugeni wa Yesu,
Muzishimane.
2. Sohoka muri Babuloni, wiyizire mu Ijambo,
Ijambo ry'Imana ry'igihe cyacu,
Umugeni wa nyuma namara kwinjira,
Twe tuzishimana na Yesu.
3. Icyo dushime Imana yo itaturetse,
Ngo tuzire ibyaha byaturembeje,
Ikigira Umwana, ikaducungura,
Idukunda cyane, nishimwe.

title: BAVA HIRYA NO HINO
lyrics:
28. BAVA HIRYA NO HINO
1. Bava hirya no hino, mu mahanga ya kure,
Kwishimana n'Umwami abatumirwa be,
Mbega abanyamugisha, batumbira ubwiza bwe,
Burabagirana, bagiriwe ubuntu bwe,
Nk'Amasaro y'ikamba rye.
R/Nishimye kuva igihe Yesu uwo yambohoye,
Si nkikoreye ayo maganya yamberaga umutwaro,
Nabaga mu mwijima ariko wahunze,
None ubu mfite insinzi kuko Yesu yambohoye.
2. Nabonye intebe ye yera bayihagaze imbere,
Nta kurira ukundi, nta n'agahinda,
Nta rupfu mu murwa mwiza,
Umwami yambanjirije, antegurira inzira,
Vuba tuzamubona mu Ijuru iteka ryose.
3. Amarembo y'uwo murwa yuguruye amanywa, ijoro,
Reba Umukiza utugirira ubuntu,
Aduha ibyicaro byiza,
Ibyicaro muri uwo murwa byaduteguriwe,
Twitegure ibirori, umva guhamagarwa.
4. Yesu agiye kugaruka, imibabaro yose ishire,
Niba Umwami wacu aje aka kanya,
Kubwo abatagira icyaha,
Mbese wagira ibyishimo cyangwa se agahinda,
Ubwo azaza mu bwiza bwe, tuzahurira mu ibicu?

title: NIMUHUNGE UMUJINYA
lyrics:
29. NIMUHUNGE UMUJINYA
1. Igihe umwuzure utsemba abatuye isi,
Umugabo Nowa yarabihishuriwe,
Yatumwe n'Imana kwibariza inkuge,
Abwiye ab'isi, banga kumwumvira.
R/Nimuhunge, muhunge umujinya ugiye
Gutsemba abanze kwihana,
Nowa yabwirije kwibariza inkuge,
Abibwiye ab'isi, banga kumwumvira.
2. Igihe i Sodomu bajya kurimbuka,
Hajya aba Marayika ntibabihishurirwa,
Bageze kwa Loti umugaragu w'Imana,
Abishwe n'irari bashaka kubangiza.
3. Dore ubu imperuka igeze bugufi,
Mwese muhungire mu Ijambo ry'igihe,
Kuko yabibwiye Umuhanuzi Malaki ati:
"Nzaboherereza Umuhanuzi Eliya."
Maze Eliya aje, banga kumwumvira,
Bihakana Intumwa n'Ijambo yatumwe.
4. Yemwe gisekuru cy'i Lawodikiya, mufite Ubutumwa,
Mukanga kubwemera,
Inkingi y'Umuriro yaragaragaye,
Yarije guhamya Umuhanuzi yatumye,
Ni muri Malaki gatatu havuga,
Mwese mumwumvire kandi mumwemere.

title: UBUHUNGIRO NI YESU
lyrics:
30. UBUHUNGIRO NI YESU
R/Ubuhungiro ni Yesu,
Umufasha utabura mu byago,
Uri mwiza Yesu, uri mwiza,
Ntawe nakugereranya.
1. Mu bihe bibi uransanga,
Uti: "mwana wanjye humura,
Ndikumwe nawe, wigira ubwoba,
Nzakurinda, reka kwiheba."
2. Daniyeli nawe yaramusanze,
Ati: "mwana wanjye humura,
Ndikumwe nawe, wigira ubwoba,
Ndakurinda ziriya ntare."
3. Na Mose ageze ku Nyanja Itukura,
Ati: "mwana wanjye humura,
Rambura inkoni naniye naguhaye,
Hejuru y'amazi urabona inzira.

title: UYU NIWE BAVUZE
lyrics:
31. UYU NIWE BAVUZE
R/Uyu niwe bavuze uzaza uri mu bicu,
Nk'uko Luka abitubwira makumyabiri na rimwe,
Umurongo wa makumyabiri na karindwi,
Aya niyo magambo yasize yivugiye.
1. Mwubure amaso murebe nguyu ari mu bicu,
Ku musozi Saniseti niho yagaragaye,
Nguriya ari ku muryango, nimumukingurire.
2. Igitangaza kiravuga igihe cya nimugoroba,
Umusozi Saniseti umanukaho igihu cyenda,
Gukabakaba hasi, abantu barahurura.
3. Bazana abanyamakuru mu binyamakuru bitatu,
Bibonera ibitangaza bibaye muri Amerika,
Inkurunziza ikwira hose igera no kumpera z'isi.
4. Tega amatwi wiyumvire bino binyamakuru:
Icya mbere cyitwa "Look" bisobanura kureba,
Icya kabiri ni "Time" bisobanura igihe,
Icya gatatu ni "Life" bisobanura ubuzima.
Niba ufite Enterineti, reba kuri Google yawe,
Duble V incuro eshatu, akadomo Branham, akadomo doti kome,
Niho usanga buno butumwa bw'igihe cyacu,
Tuje tumwiringira, niwe wadukubitiwe,
Rimwe rizira kabiri arapfa, arazuka,
None ubu ni muzima.

title: NIYO UMURABA
lyrics:
32. NIYO UMURABA
1. Isirayeli iva muri Egiputa,
Imbere yabo hari inyanja,
Bambutse ubutayu na Yorodani,
Ubwo bafunguye amarembo y'umwanzi.
R/Niyo umuraba wahuha cyane,
Ndetse n'isi nayo igatigita,
Icyo nshaka n'Ijuru nasezeranijwe,
Ntacyambuza gukomeza.
2. Yobu yahuye n'ibigeragezo,
Inshuti ze zose zimucikaho,
We yarizeye iramukiza,
Ubwo aba afunguye amarembo y'umwanzi.
3. Saduraka, Meshaki na Abedenego,
Batawe mu itanura ry'umuriro,
Iyo bizeye irabakiza,
Ubwo bafunguye amarembo y'umwanzi.
4. Daniyeli yatawe mu rwobo rw'intare,
Azira gusenga Imana nzima,
Iyo yizeye izifunga iminwa,
Ubwo abafunguye amarembo y'umwanzi.
5. Naho waterwa n'ibigeragezo,
Wicika intege, komeza urugendo,
Ntuhagarare, ntuhungabane,
Ufungure ayo marembo y'umwanzi.

title: YEMWE MWA BANYAMADINI MWE
lyrics:
33. YEMWE MWA BANYAMADINI MWE
R/Yemwe mwa banyamadini mwe,
Mwebwe abize Tewolojiya, ninde
Wabonye inkingi y'umuriro
Imwihishurira ngo imuhe ubutumwa?
1. Sawuli mu nzira ijya i Damasiko,
Agiye kurwanya ubwoko bw'Imana,
Inkingi y'umuriro ihita imanuka iti:
"Sawuli, urandenganyiriza iki?"
Nawe ati "urinde Mwami nka gukorera?"
Nawe ati "ni Yesu uhora utoteza."
2. Ijambo ry'Imana ntiryigwa mu mashuri,
Uzabaze Nimurodi n'abambari be,
Igihe bubaka umunara w'i Babeli,
Imana bose ibahananturira rimwe.
3. Ijambo ry'Imana kuki muryibagirwa,
Niba mwemera iyi ntumwa Pawulo,
Ko yabatinije mu Izina rya Yesu,
Mwebwe mukabatiriza mu butatu?
4. Umwanditsi w'Ivanjiri witwa Matayo,
Abisobanura neza kuri ibi bice,
Soma ku gice cya cumi na gatanu,
Umurongo waho nuwa gatandatu,
Ngo Ijambo ry'Imana mwarihinduye ubusa,
Ngo mwikomereza imigenzo yanyu gusa,
Ariko utazigisha wese nk'Intumwa,
Nawe navumwe niko Ijambo ryayo riri.

title: ISI ISHAJE NTIYANZIRIKA
lyrics:
34. ISI ISHAJE NTIYANZIRIKA
1. Iyisi ishaje ntiyanzirika,
Nzigendera igihe cyose,
Kuko namwiyeguriye,
Nkaba nambaye Umwenda w'Ubukwe.
2. Kutizera ntikwanzirika,
Nzigendera igihe cyose,
Kuko namwiyeguriye,
Nkaba nambaye Umwenda w'Ubukwe.
3. Imibabaro ntiyanzirika,
Nzigendera igihe cyose,
Kuko namwiyeguriye,
Nkaba nambaye Umwenda w'Ubukwe.
4. Uburwayi ntibwanzirika,
Nzigendera igihe cyose,
Kuko namwiyeguriye,
Nkaba nambaye Umwenda w'Ubukwe.

title: GIRA VUBA WINJIRE
lyrics:
35. GIRA VUBA WINJIRE
1. Tukiri mu madini ntitwari tuzi ukuri,
Ariko Umwami Imana iradutabara,
Yohereza Umuhanuzi Branham,
Mana warakoze.
R/Gira vuba winjire mu rugo rw'Imana,
Hanze hazaba imbwa n'abarozi.
2. Muri ibi bihe bya nyuma turimo,
Abakristo bariyoberanya,
Bagakora ibyo bishakiye,
Ariko Yesu agiye kugaruka gutwara Umugeni.
3. Yewe Mugeni warasohotse,
Ariko Mugeni icyo wamenye kibwire abandi,
Kugira ngo dusangire Ijuru.

title: MWENE DATA
lyrics:
36. MWENE DATA
R/Mwene Data wumva ubu butumwa,
Wizuyaza kandi wishidikanya,
Dore isezerano riri bugufi,
Utazatungurwa haraje integuza.
Uko byari bimeze kwa Nowa n'uyu munsi,
Niko bikimeze.
Uko byari bimeze kwa Loti n'uyu munsi,
Niko bikimeze.
1. Imyaka ijana na makumyabiri Nowa yamaze,
Yubaka inkuge abwira abantu ko umwuzure
Uje kuba, abenshi biterera agati mu ryinyo.
2. Yabaje inkuge abwiriza n'Ubutumwa,
Ab'icyo gihe bose bari kumuseka,
Ijambo ry'Imana riza gusohora,
Inkuge yuzuye, Nowa arinjira,
Imana imwereka ibyo azarokora,
Umwuzure uje, ibindi byose urabitsemba.
3. Branham muri iki gisekuru niwe wabashije
Guhura n'Imana imuhishurira ibyari ubwiru,
Byose bimwe Yohana yabujijwe kwandika.
4. Inkingi y'Umuriro agihura nayo, imuha ubutumwa,
Ashyira amahanga yose, asengera abarwayi,
Benshi barakira, ndetse n'abapfuye bamwe barazuka.

title: UBUTUMWA BWIZA
lyrics:
37. UBUTUMWA BWIZA
R/Ubutumwa bwiza buratangwa ku mabande n'ama Brochure,
Ngo bizaba ibihamya ku byo twasezeranijwe,
Kuko isezerano ryacu ryasohoye.
1. Imana koko isohoza isezerano,
Yo yatubwiye iti:
"Nzabaha Umuhanuzi Eliya,
Umunsi ukomeye kandi uteje ubwoba,
Icyo gihe uzaba utaragera."
2. Yesu ati: "Ninjye nzira, ukuri n'ubugingo,
Ntawe ujya kwa Data ntamujyanyeyo,
Ntimuhagarike imitima yanyu,
Mwizere Imana, nanjye munyizere."
3. Nowa igihe yabazaga inkuge,
Yari yeretswe ko umwuzure ugiye kuba,
Abwira abantu inkuge, baramuseka,
Umwuzure uje urabatwara, ngo bibarize.
4. Niba wemera ko Imana itajya ibeshya,
Soma Matayo makumyabiri na kane,
Umurongo nuwa cumi na kane,
Hatege amatwi wumve ukuntu havuga,
Nibwo ubutumwa bwiza bw'Ubwami buzigishwa
Mu isi yose, ngo buhe ubuhamya
Bwo guhamiriza amahanga yose,
Nibwo imperuka izahera ko ize.

title: MU MAHANGA BIRANZE
lyrics:
IV. KWIHANA
38. MU MAHANGA BIRANZE
1. Mu mahanga biranze,
Isirayeli iragaruwe,
Ibimenyetso byahanuwe,
Iminsi irashize,
Yuzuye amaganya,
Vuba n'ibihe bidashira.
R/Umunsi wo gucungurwa uri hafi,
Imitima ifite ubwoba,
Ngwino wuzure Umwuka, tegura itara,
Ugucungurwa kuregereje.
2. Amajuru aranyeganyega,
Abenshi ntibazi, ibirimo biraberamo,
Komera Torero, nyeganyega ganza,
Ugucungurwa kuregereje.
3. Umutini urarabije,
Yerusalemu iragaruwe,
Iryo shyanga ryari ryaranyazwe,
Irahamagara,
Imvura ya nyuma iragwa,
Nyaruka wowe ugisigaye.
4. Abanyabinyoma bahora babeshya,
Bati "Yesu Kristo siwe Mana,"
Bahakana ukuri, ntibahishurirwa,
Twebwe dukurikiye Intumwa.

title: BANGUKA WIHANE
lyrics:
39. BANGUKA WIHANE
R/Banguka, banguka wihane,
Ni wowe Mugeni wari utegerejwe,
Ikanzu yawe yasohotse mu ruganda,
Impeta yawe icurwa n'umunyabuhanga,
Mukundwa banguka, Umukwe araje.
1. Banguka dore Umukwe araje,
Araje, araje kandi ntagisibya,
Dore impanda ya Marayika wa karindwi,
Irimo iravuga ko nta kindi gihe gisigaye.
2. Banguka akubabarire ibyaha,
Umese ikanzu mu Maraso ya Yesu,
Kugira ngo naza asange nta kizinga,
Wihane ubu jya muri Yorodani ubatizwe.
3. Pawulo yabajije abizera ati:
"Mwatijwe ubatizo ki?"
Abandi nabo bamusubiza bati:
"Ni uwa Yohana,"
Barongera barabatizwa.
4. Babatijwe mu Izina ry'Umwami Yesu,
Tubisanga mu byakozwe n'Intumwa,
Umutwe n'uwa cumi n'icyenda,
Umurongo wa gatanu.
5. Yesu niwe nshuti itajya ihemuka,
Niwe Gitare cyemeye kudukubitirwa,
Yemera gupfa ndetse arazuka ngo dukire,
Umwizera wese abone ubugingo.

title: UBUNTU BWA YESU
lyrics:
40. UBUNTU BWA YESU
1. Yewe ubuntu bwa Yesu, ntibugira akagero,
Kuko nahoze mu byaha, mu mwijima nd'impumyi,
Nuko mpura na Yesu, agenda ashaka intama ze,
Ati "ngwino ngukize, mubo nshaka urimo."
R/Ndagusaba imbaraga, Mwami Mana y'urukundo,
Wangize umwana wawe, Data mfata ukuboko,
Dore uri hafi kugaruka, kujyana Umugeni wawe.
2. Angejeje mu buntu bwe, yanyuhagije Amaraso,
Ankuraho imyanda yose, nambikwa imyambaro yera,
Ubushwambagara bwose, abujugunya ahatibukwa,
Amara inyota n'inzara, anyitaho n'uyu munsi.
3. Isi n'ibibi byayo byose, sinari buzabisige,
Nuko nabonye Umukiza, anshoboza kubizinukwa,
None rero wa isi we, nawe mubiri nambaye,
Nubwo mumpagurukiye, mfite Yesu uzabankiza.
R/Mfite amasezerano, na nyirayo ni muzima,
Ntacyamuhagarika, cyatuma atayasohoza,
Mpishwe mu mababaye, nk'Ikizu n'umwana wacyo.
4. Amadini nahozemo, yaje kuyansohoramo,
Ambwira ko atariho aba, bamuta inyuma y'urugo,
Ati "dore ibyo bavuga, bihabanye n'ibyo bakora,
Babyitwaza kubwo indamu, nawe warabaretse."
R/Yampishuriye ubutumwa, bw'igihe cy'umugoroba,
Anyereka iki gihe cyanyuma, n'Umuhanuzi yagitumyeho,
Ngomba gusa n'Ubutumwa, nibwo nzagera mu Ijuru,
Kubumenya ntacyo bimaze, utagenda uko buvuga.
5. Nkweretse bene data, abo waguze Amaraso,
Abo waduhurije muri iki gisekuruza,
Turindire muri wowe, urukundo rudutegeke,
Maze uturwanirire, nta numwe wakwishoboza.
R/Jya mu batakumenye, nabo ubihishurire,
Komeza umugeni wawe, dukomeze isezerano,
Maze tugutegereze, turi Itorero ryishyitse.

title: GARUKA MWAMI
lyrics:
41. GARUKA MWAMI
1. Habwa ikuzo Mucunguzi,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Wowe wadukunze kera,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
R/Ngwino Mwami kubana bawe,
Tugutegerezanye imitima imenetse,
Isi igeze ku iherezo,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
2. Wowe wasize ingoma yawe,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Wigize umuntu udukize,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
3. Waducunguje Amaraso,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Wabambwe turabamburwa,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
4. Byose bigiye gushira,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Turaguhimbaza Mwami,
Ngwino turagutegereje.

title: ABIBAZA
lyrics:
42. ABIBAZA
1. Harimo abibaza ku munsi w'imperuka,
Bagashaka guhinyura Uwiteka Nyiringabo,
Mwibuke ibyo yabwiye Daniyeli Umuhanuzi ati:
"Bumba iki gitabo ugifatanishe n'ikimenyetso,
Kugeza igihe cy'imperuka, benshi baza jaragira hirya no hino,
Kandi ubwenge buzagwira."
R/Banguka, banguka, banguka munyabyaha,
Jya muri Yorodani, uvemo utunganye,
Wozwe ibyaha byawe, dore Uwiteka araje,
Aje gutwara Umugeni udafite ikizinga.
2. Ibihanura kuza kw'integuza y'Uwiteka,
Ntibizagire uwo bitungura,
Yarateguje ndetse n'igisekuru cyacu cya Lawodokiya,
Yadutumyeho Umuhanuzi Branham.
3. Muri iyo mirsi kandi, aba Yesu bazezwa,
Bacishwe mu ruganda, bavemo batunganye,
Naho inkozi z'ibibi zigume mu bibi byazo,
Nta numwe muri bo uzamenya,
Umunyabwenge azamenya.

title: TUJE KUGUSABA
lyrics:
43. TUJE KUGUSABA
1. Tuje kugusaba Mana,
Twicishije bugufi,
Imitware yacu yose,
Iraturemereye.
R/Tuje imbere yawe n'imitima imenetse,
Twumve, twumve Yesu, uruhure imitima yacu.
2. Waradusezeranije tujye tugusaba,
Dufite kwizera kose uzajye udusubiza.
3. Imitima yacu yose iri ku kuganyira,
Reba ibyo byatunanije, ubidukureho.
4. Nta wundi dufite ku isi wabasha kudukiza,
Ni wowe gusa twizeye, ngwino uturwanirire.
5. Mana turagutabaza, wumve gusenga kwacu,
Ibyo tugusaba byose ubiduhere ubuntu.

title: UMUNSI W'URUBANZA
lyrics:
44. UMUNSI W'URUBANZA
1. Umunsi w'urubanza waratangiye,
Watangiye umunsi wumvagaho Ubutumwa,
Iyo wumva Ubutumwa ntubukurikize,
Menya ko nta museke uzagutambikira.
R/Isuzume Mwene Data, isuzume,
Mbese witwara ute imbere y'Ibyanditswe?
Mbese ntimuzi ko imibiri yanyu
Ari insengero z'Umwuka uri muri mwe?
2. Dore Imana yacu yohereje Ubutumwa,
Ngo butuyobore, butumurikire,
Nyamara amadini yo yanze kuyoborwa,
Ariyoborerwa n'inzego yashyizeho.
3. Ijambo ritubwira ko hari Imana imwe,
Rikatubwira na none Umubatizo umwe,
Intumwa zabatije mu Izina rya Yesu,
Nawe tubona wabatijwe mu butatu.
4. Abantu benshi barayobagurika,
Bashakisha inzira yabageza mu Ijuru,
Nyamara nta yindi y'ukuri bazabona,
Nta wabatijwe mu butatu.
5. Yesu ari hafi kuzamura Itorero,
Arashyira ikimenyetso kubamwumviye,
Abatamwumviye bagiye kurimbuka,
Nimwiyeze, dore dutegereje Umukwe.

title: NIMWIYEZE
lyrics:
45. NIMWIYEZE
1. Mugeni we witeguye kuzabana n'Umukwe,
Wirimbishe n'imirimo myiza,
Kugira ngo uzabane n'Umukwe.
R/Nimwiyeze (x2):
Mwirimbishe imirimo myiza,
Hasigaye igihe gito akagaruka.
2. Mu rugendo twatangiye harimo intambara nyinshi cyane,
None Mugeni uri mu rugendo ube maso kandi uhore usenga.
3. Muri ibi bihe bya nyuma turimo, twabonye Ubutumwa bw'igihe cyacu,
Ariyo nkuge y'Umugeni, tubugenderemo,
Tuzabane n'Imana iteka.

title: BYOSE MURI WE
lyrics:
V. UBUMANA BWA YESU KRISTO
46. BYOSE MURI WE
1. Ushobora byose ni Yesu,
Mwami w'amahoro,
Data w'Iteka ryose,
Umwami w'Ubwiza,
Umukozi w'Umuhanga,
Byose byaremwe na We,
Muri Yesu huzuye Ubumana Bwose.
R/Byose muri We (x2),
Muri Yesu huzuye Ubumana bwose,
Byose muri We (x2),
Yesu ashobora byose,
Byose muri We.
2. Imanweli Imana na twe,
Yehova Uwiteka,
Umwuka uba hose,
Wuzuye ikirere,
Umutambyi Mukuru,
Ntama y'abanyabyaha,
Yazanye Ubucunguzi, hakuzwe Izina Rye.
3. Uwambere n'Uheruka,
Alpha na Omega,
Jambo yabaye Umuntu,
Inshuti y'Abacunguwe,
Ubwenge n'ubuhanga,
Ukuri n'ububasha,
Ibyo nkeneye byose mbibona muri We.
4. Imana twari turinze,
Izaba indirimbo nziza,
Isirayeli igarutse,
Yesu agaragaye,
Azaza kubohora,
Ntama yacu yatambwe,
Yuzuye Ubumana bwose,
Yatsinze umwijima.

title: NI INDE
lyrics:
47. NI INDE
1. Uguhishurirwa kutari Yesu,
Ubutumwa bwose butabwiriza Yesu,
Ugusenga kose kutari Yesu,
Guhimbaza kose kutari Yesu Kristo,
Undi Yesu utari umwe wabambwe,
Urubyaro rw'Imana uwo ntirwamwemera.
R/Ni inde, ni inde, tuzashima utari Yesu?
Ni inde, ni inde utari Yesu Imana nzima?
2. Yabumbuye igitabo cyo gucungurwa,
Niwe Ntama y'Imana ikiza ibyaha by'abantu,
Niwe zuba ry'ukuri ritumurikira,
Ni nawe Mugabo wo guhamya w'ukuri,
Ubutumwa bwe si ubwa Seminali,
Si Tewolojiya, ni ubwa Yesu n'imbaraga.
3. Hano ku isi yari Umuhanuzi,
Naho mu bwiza bwe akaba ari Umutambyi,
Ubwo azagaruka azaba ari Umwami,
Ubonye ubwiza bwe aba agirirwe ubuntu,
Yambaye umubiri araducungura,
Ni We gusa wabaye mu isi adacumura.
4. Amagambo y'abantu ni imfabusa,
Amagambo ya Yesu aryohera umunyabyaha,
Umwe ubera byose abamwizera,
Wa wundi utabura mu minuho y'urugendo,
Urwanirira abe ni We duhimbaza,
Umwe ubera abe igisubizo mu bibazo.
5. Yesu yagendagenze mu bisekuruza,
Ni We warindiye Itorero k'Urutare,
Ufashe inyenyeri ndwi mu kuboko kw'iburyo,
Waduhaye Ubutumwa butacuzwe n'abantu,
Uwagaragaye mu Nkingi y'igicu,
Yiveretse Pawulo, yiyereka Branham.
6. Nta muntu nka We, nta ubwiriza nka We,
Nta Ntumwa nka We, nta Muhanuzi nka We,
Nta Mujyanama nka We, Umuririmbyi nka We,
Nta rurimi rwabasha kuvuga ibye byose,
Ntawe basangiye icyubahiro cye,
Icyubahiro cye ntabwo azagiha umuntu.

title: HOZIYANA
lyrics:
48. HOZIYANA
1. Duhimbaze Umwami kuko akwiriye gushimwa (x2)
Hoziyana, oooh ahimbazwe Igitare cyanjye.
2. Izina rye risingizwe,
Koko ari ku ngoma iteka (x2).
3. Izina rye Yehovayire,
Yita ku bibazo byanjye (x2).
4. Izina rye Yehovarafa,
Akiza uburwayi bwanjye (x2).
5. Izina rye Yehova Shalomu,
Imana iduha amahoro (x2).
6. Izina rye Yehovah Shama,
Ari hano hamwe natwe (x2).
7. Izina rye Yehovanisi,
Ni bendera ryanjye Mwami.

title: NTABWO NZIGERA NSAZA
lyrics:
49. NTABWO NZIGERA NSAZA
1. Dutegereje impanda y'Imana,
Twishime tumuhe icyubahiro,
Kuko ubukwe bwegereje vuba,
Ntabwo nzigera nsaza, Haleluya (x2).
R/Haleluya, Haleluya, Amen,
Haleluya, Haleluya, Amen,
Ntabwo nzigera nsaza, Haleluya.
2. Bizala ku musozi w'i Siyoni,
Nta rupfu, nta bwoba, nta kubabara,
Tuzaba mu mahoro n'urukundo,
Ntabwo nzigera nsaza, Haleluya.
3. Nti hazabaho umucyo w'izuba,
Nti hazabaho umucyo w'ukwezi,
Nti hazabaho umucyo w'isi,
Ntabwo nzigera nsaza, Haleluya.
4. Umwana w'Intama azamurika,
Mu murwa wera Yerusalemu,
Umurwa wateguriwe Umugeni,
Ntabwo nzigera nsaza, Haleluya.

title: YARI YESU
lyrics:
50. YARI YESU
R/Yari Yesu, yari Yesu,
Muri ya nkingi y'Umuriro yari Yesu.
1. Igihe cya Mose yari Yesu...
Muri ya nkingi y'Umuriro yari Yesu.
2. Igihe cya Eliya yari Yesu...
Muri ya nkingi y'Umuriro yari Yesu.
3. Igihe cya Sawuli yari Yesu...
Muri ya nkingi y'Umuriro yari Yesu.
4. Igihe cya Branham yari Yesu...
Muri ya nkingi y'Umuriro yari Yesu.

title: KU MUNSI W'UMWAMI WACU
lyrics:
51. KU MUNSI W'UMWAMI WACU
1. Ku munsi w'Umwami wacu narindi mu Mwuka,
Numva ijwi inyuma yanjye rimeze nk'iry'imparida,
Riti "Yohana, zamuka uze hano,
Nkwereke ibikwiriye kuba nyuma y'ibyo."
R/Yewe Yohana we, ngwino nkwereke,
Uwicaye kuri ya ntebe yasaga na Yasipi, ngwino...
Yasaga na Sarudiyo...
Uwambere nka Rubeni, uwanyuma nka Benyamini,
Itangiriro n'iherezo, Alpha na Omega,
Umuhanuzi mukuru, ni Umwami wacu Yesu,
Oh Yohana we...
2. Hanyuma y'ibyo mbona mu Ijuru ry'Imana,
Urugi rukinguye mbona intebe y'Ubwami,
Kandi uwari yicaye ku ntebe y'Ubwami,
Yasaga na Yasipi hamwe na Sarudiyo.
3. Intebe yose igoswe n'umukororombya,
Wasaga n'ibuye ryitwa Samaragido,
Umukororombya ufite amabara arindwi,
Agereranya ibihe birindwi by'Itorero.
4. Hagati yiyo ntebe no kuyizenguruka,
Hari ibizima bine kandi byuzuye amaso,
Ikizima cya mbere cyasaga n'intare,
Ikizima cya kabiri gisa n'ikimasa,
Icya gatatu mu maso hasa n'ah'umuntu,
Naho icya kane gisa n'Ikizu kiguruka.

title: MBEGA UMUNSI W'UBWIZA
lyrics:
VI. UMWUKA WERA
52. MBEGA UMUNSI W'UBWIZA
R/Umunsi w'ubwiza, Yesu yambohoye,
Mbega umunezero, Yesu yambohoye.
1. Iminyururu y'ibyaha Yesu yambohoye (x3)
Mbega umunezero, Yesu yambohoye.
2. Si njyewe ukiriho, ni Kristo muri njye (x3)
Mbega umunezero, Yesu yambohoye.
3. Natoranijwe isi itarabaho (x3)
Mbega umunezero, Yesu yambohoye.

title: UBUTUMWA BWA KERA
lyrics:
53. UBUTUMWA BWA KERA
1. Ni wa Mwuka Wera wa kera, satani ntiyawegera,
Niyo mpamvu abantu bawutinya,
Njye umbera mwiza.
R/Mpereza, Ubutumwa bwa kera (x3),
Njye mumbera bwiza.
2. Ni bwiza nta bundi nshaka,
Butuma nkunda Mwene Data,
Bushyira byose ahabona,
Njye mumbera bwiza.
3. Buzamaraho ibinyoma byawe,
Buzagukiza urupfu,
Butuma dayimoni ihunga,
Njye mumbera bwiza.
4. Bwari bwiza kuri ba Data,
Bwiza kuri Pawulo na Sira,
Ni bwiza kuri Frere Branham,
Njye mumbera bwiza.

title: UMUNSI UKOMEYE URAGEZE
lyrics:
54. UMUNSI UKOMEYE URAGEZE
1. Umunsi ukomeye twagenderewemo,
Dore ibihe bishya,
Turirimbe ishimwe duhawe na Kristo,
Icyo yasezeranye,
Mwuka Wera ari hano.
R/Mwuka Wera ari hano (x2),
Urupfu rwarabuze, itanze agakiza,
Kandi mu isi yose umunsi ukomeye,
Mwuka Wera ari hano.
2. Umwijima urahunze,
Umucyo waraje wirukane ubwoba,
Kutizera kose, Umwami w'abami,
Atanze kwizera, Mwuka Wera ari hano.
3. Umuhoza ukomeye aje kutwuzuza,
Umwuka w'Ukuri no kutubohora,
Aratubatuye, atanze gukira,
Mwuka Wera ari hano.
4. Abacunguwe bose baririmbe umudendezo,
Kristo yashohoje byose,
Atanga Umwuka ukuzimu guhinze umushyitsi,
Kuko mu isi yose Mwuka Wera ari hano.

title: YANESHEJE URUPFU
lyrics:
55. YANESHEJE URUPFU
1. Yanesheje urupfu n'ikuzimu,
Naho yajanjaguye umutwe w'inzoka,
Uwo ibyanditswe bihamiriza,
Mwami uturokore.
R/Basirikare imbere, Amen,
Basirikare imbere,
Bakristo turi mu ntambara itarigeze kurwanwa,
Tujye ku rugamba, Bene Data bashiki bacu,
Twikorere Umusaraba.
2. Niwe uneshereza abizera bose,
Abisunga Ijambo rye uko ringana,
Nibo yuzuza Umwuka we Wera,
Mwami utuyobore.
3. Mbere yo kuremwa kw'ibintu byose,
Twari turi mu bitekerezo bye,
Yadutoreye kuturokora,
Mwami uduhire.

title: NDAMARANIRA KWEGERA
lyrics:
56. NDAMARANIRA KWEGERA
1. Ndamaranira kugera imbere y'Ijambo,
Kugira ngo mfate icyo Yesu yanzigamiye,
Nubwo mu nzira huzuyemo ibisitaza,
Yesu yamanitse ibendera ryo kunesha.
R/Sinzatinya nubwo umwanzi yantera,
Nubwo inzira nshamo nayo iruhije,
Iyatangije urugendo muri njye,
Niyo izarusohoza.
2. Nubwo ngifite uburame bwo kuba mu Ijambo,
Ngakora byose niringiye ingororano,
Kandi ubwo ndiho ngifatanya n'abazima,
Umwami niwe uzampa gukora ibyo ashima.
3. Sinahagarika umutima mu rugendo,
Kuko mfite abahamya benshi banesheje,
Kubwo indakuka bagiraga mu mitima,
Ishavu ryabo ryabizezaga ibyishimo.
Bazereraga hirya no hino,
Mu misozi no mu bihanamanga,
Yemwe n'isi ntiyarikwiriye ko bayigumamo.
4. Nirwo rukumbuzi rumbyiga mu mutima,
Kuko abo bose bandindiye ngo tubane,
Mu gitondo cyiza gitonyanga amahoro,
Aho amajune azajugunywa imuhero.
Aho nzitwa izina ryanjye rishya,
Rihwanye n'imirimo nakoze,
Umutima wanjye uzibagirwa ibiteye ubwoba.
5. Ndindiriye ko amarembo y'Ijuru akingurwa,
Ibyo nabwiwe n'Ijambo bigasohora,
Umutima wanjye ukava mu bwihebe,
Nkaririmba indirimbo nshya yabanesheje.
Abakozi bose bateranye,
Isarura naryo rirangiye,
Umusaruro w'abacunguwe uzaba mu Ijuru.

title: NTACYO NDICYO NTAGUFITE
lyrics:
57. NTACYO NDICYO NTAGUFITE
1. Ntacyo ndicyo ntagufite,
Yesu ndinda ikibi cyose,
Nzanezerwa iminsi yose,
Nkugende bugufi Mwami wanjye.
R/Njyane nawe ibihe byose,
Unsubirize isengesho,
Nzanezerwa ibihe byose,
Nkugende bugufi Mwami wanjye.
2. Muri iyi isi y' imiruho,
Tubuze uwaturindaga,
Waturuhuraga imitwaro,
Ntawundi ni Wowe Mwami wanjye.
3. Ubuzima burangiye,
Nshoje urugendo rw'isi,
Mwami wanjye uzambe hafi,
Ku nkombe yo mu Bwami bwawe.

title: YESU ARI MURI NJYE
lyrics:
58. YESU ARI MURI NJYE
1. Nishimye amanywa n'ijoro,
Ndi umugenzi mu isi,
Mu buzima mbona ukuboko kw'Imana,
Byishimo njye mfite, ibanga ry'ibyo byose,
Umuhumuriza ari muri njye.
R/Andimo (x2),
Haleluya ari muri njye...
Uko ngenda mu nzira nishimye amanywa n'ijoro,
Umuhumuriza ari muri njye.
2. Niberaga mu byaha, nta mahoro na make,
Kugeza igihe Yesu ubwo yampiraga,
Ubwo njye ndamuramya, anyuzuza amahoro,
Umuhumuriza ari muri njye.
3. Hose ari kumwe nanjye, azi ibibazo mfite,
Nezerewe kandi mbohowe nk'inyoni,
Mwaka Wera anyoboye, abaza ubugingo bwanjye,
Umuhumuriza ari muri njye.
4. Nta nyota y'isi mfite, kwinezeza bishize,
Hashize igihe cyinshi mbivuyemo,
Umwijima ukuweho, antuye n'imitwaro,
Umuhumuriza ari muri njye.

title: CANA UMURIRO
lyrics:
59. CANA UMURIRO
R/Cana umuriro,
Uboneshereze isi yose,
Uhamanye n'Umwuka Wera,
Mu bikorwa byawe.
1. Cana umuriro,
Isi yose Umwuka Wera akubemo,
Umuhamye no mu bandi batarabona umucyo,
Isi yose ibone agakiza,
Umwuka Wera amanuke.
2. I Damasiko hari umwigishwa witwaga Ananiya,
Umwami Yesu aramubonekera,
Aramuhamagara ati "Ananiya,"
Nawe ati "karame Mwami,"
Umwami ati "haguruka ujye mu nzira igororotse,
Ushakire mu nzu ya Yuda umuntu witwa Sawuli."
3. Cana umuriro,
Uboneshereze isi yose,
Nk'uko Ananiya yagiye gusengera Sawuli,
Ako kanya arahumuka,
Ahita avuga Ubutumwa.

title: NUBABARA JY'USENGA
lyrics:
60. NUBABARA JY'USENGA
1. Igihe ubabaye jy'usenga Imana,
Bifasha umutima ubabaye,
Kwihanganira ibigeragezo,
Biwufasha no kunesha.
R/Niba ufite umutima ubabaye,
Ukaba uremerewe uruhijwe,
Pfukama usenge Umukiza wawe,
Nawe aragutabara.
2. Na Yobu yarari mu bimuruhije,
Indwara y'ibishyuti yamurembeje,
Yarasenze Imana iramukiza,
Kubera yasengaga.
3. Daniyeli ari mu rwobo rw'intare,
Yafashijwe nuko yasengaga,
Imana ibumba iminwa y'intare,
Kubera amasengesho.
4. Saduraka, Meshaki, Abedenego,
Banze gusenga ikigirwamana,
Maze Yesu arabiyereka,
Babana mu muriro.

title: NZAMUHA IKI?
lyrics:
VII. UMUGENI WA KRISTO
61. NZAMUHA IKI?
R/Nzamuha iki Yesu, nzamuha iki?
Nzamuha iki kumushima? (x2)
1. Umuhanuzi uyu dufite, Imana niyo yamuduhaye,
Yamuduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
2. Iri Jambo iri dufite, Imana niyo yariduhaye,
Yariduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
3. Amahoro aya dufite, Imana niyo yayaduhaye,
Yayaduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
4. Agakiza aka dufite, Imana niyo yakaduhaye,
Yakaduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
5. Ukuri uku dufite, Imana niyo yakuduhaye,
Yakuduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
6. Inzira iyi dufite, Imana niyo yayiduhaye,
Yayiduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.
7. Ibyishimo ibi dufite, Imana niyo yabiduhaye,
Yabiduhaye ntacyo tuyihaye,
Nzamuha iki kumushima.

title: MUGENI BA MASO
lyrics:
62. MUGENI BA MASO
R/Mugeni ba maso, yewe Mugeni ba maso,
Mugeni ba maso utegereze Yesu.
1. Iy' isi turimo yuzuye ibibazo gusa,
Nuyirebaho rero urahezwa nayo,
Ibiyikorerwamo ni bibi gusa gusa,
Ntabyiza biyirimo, irebere Umwami.
2. Dore ibyo byose ubona birimo gukorwa,
Barimo bavumbura kugirango uyobe,
Barahindura byose bazana amajyambere,
Ariko ibyo byose ni ukugira ngo urangare.
3. Reba Ijambo gusa icyo rigusezeranya,
Reba Yesu waguhamagaye aguhe Agakiza,
Dore yakubwiye kuba maso igihe cyose,
Kuko isi ayizi ibiyikorerwamo.
4. Mugeni wa Yesu wagiriwe ubuntu cyane,
Ndetse warasohotse ariko sibyo gusa,
Ugomba gukora icyo iri Jambo rivuga,
Ube maso nkuko Elisa yabigenje.
5. Umere nk'umugenzi iyo ari ku rugendo,
Aba agamije gusa gusohoza urugendo,
None nawe Mugenzi muri isi ubona,
Nturebe ku ruhande kuko turi hafi.
6. Dore Amadini yose avuga ko ahamya Yesu,
Ariko uramenye kuko nta Jambo bagira,
Izo nzira zabo ntabwo zigera mu Ijuru,
Komeza icyo wahawe utegereze Yesu.
7. Uko kwishyira hamwe urimo kubona,
Ibyo nukugira ngo babashe kukurwanya,
Wowe kora byose kugira ngo use n'Ijambo,
Ugire ibyiringiro kuko Yesu araje rwose.
8. Dore ubwo bugome bukorerwa hose ku isi,
Izo ntambara zose ubona zirwanwa,
Imitingito y'isi n'izindi ngorane,
Ibyo bikwereka ko ugiye kujya iwawe.

title: UBUKWE BW'UMWANA W'INTAMA
lyrics:
63. UBUKWE BW'UMWANA W'INTAMA
1. Ubukwe bw'Umwana w'Intama burasohoye,
Abera b'Imana tugiye kubutaha,
Mbere yo kubutaha twishakire umwambaro mwiza,
Urabagirana tubone kubutaha.
R/Uwo mwambaro n'imirimo myiza
Yo gukiranuka kw'Abera b'Imana,
Niba utawufite uzanyura he?
Abera nitwinjira uzagana he?
2. Ubukwe bwo mu isi babushakira umwambaro,
Mbese ubwo mu Ijuru ntibwaba akarusho?
Imirimo dukora niyo iduhesha umwambaro,
N'Amasengesho yacu nayo aduhesha umwambaro.
3. Uhereye none Mwami ndakwinginze,
Unyambure inzogera unyambike umwambaro,
Nta handi nabona umwambaro w'igiciro,
Wo kungeza mu bukwe keretse imbere yawe.

title: MFITE ISEZERANO
lyrics:
64. MFITE ISEZERANO
1. Mfite isezerano nabwiwe n'Uhoraho,
Ko hari izamurwa ry'Umugeni wa Yesu,
Abari mu Ijambo nibo bazazamurwa,
Iryo sezerano riri mu mitima yacu.
R/Nyabuna Mana mpa kuguma mu Ijambo,
Ningira intege nke uzajye umba bugufi,
Kuko satani ahora azererezwa,
Ashaka Mana uwabuza ubugingo,
Nyabuna Mana tabara abana bawe,
Ubarengere bategereze izamurwa.
Iy'isi turimo kuko siyo gakondo,
Ubwami tujyamo niwo Murwa w'Abera.
2. Hari urugamba tubwirizwa kurwana,
Mugihe cyose tukiri muri isi,
Inzira ducamo n' inzira y'urugamba,
Abihangana nibo bazarutsinda.
3. Hari ubugingo bubikiwe abizera,
Hari n'urupfu rurindiriye abatsinzwe,
Hari umunezero imbere y'abizera,
Hari n'agahinda imbere y'abaneshejwe.
4. Icyampa ibyanjye, bikamenywa n'Uwiteka,
Maze nkamwumvira nkagenda uko abishaka,
Maze yagaruka agasanga niteguye,
Itorero rye nanjye nkazaba muri ryo.
5. Mfite amatsiko yo kuzabona Umwami,
Nk'uko Umugeni ategereza Umukwe,
Yifuza kureba uwo munsi uruta iyindi,
Ntabwo arangazwa n'abandi batamukoye.

title: TURI IHANGA
lyrics:
65. TURI IHANGA
1. Turi ihanga ry'Imana ihoraho,
Twaguzwe Amaraso ye,
Yamenwe kubera ibyaha byacu,
Yaduhinduye abe.
2. Duhorwaho n'imiyaga kenshi,
Ariko ntidutinya,
Twubatse ku rutare rw'Iteka,
Ntitunyeganyezwa.
3. Tugenda mu Izina ry'uwanesheje,
Izina rya Yesu ukomeye,
Arikumwe natwe, itsinzi ni iyacu.
4. Dukomejwe n'Umwuka Wera,
Kubw'ubuntu bw'Imana,
Kuko twatoranijwe kera,
Tugumye tube abe.
5. Dutwaye Izina ry'uwanesheje,
Rihindisha imishyitsi,
Rinesha imbaraga z'antikristo,
Rigakiza ibyaha.
6. Vuba tuzasiga isi ishaje,
Maze tuzamurwe, duhure n'Umwami Yesu Kristo,
Twibanire iteka.

title: TUGOSWE N'URUKUNDO
lyrics:
66. TUGOSWE N'URUKUNDO
1. Tugoswe n'urukundo rwawe Mwami,
Umucyo wawe umurika nk'izuba,
Tugoswe n'urukundo rwawe Mwami,
Niyo mpamvu twakwizeye Mwami.
R/Shimwa (x2), Wowe munezero wacu,
Shimwa (x2), Wowe waducunguye,
Shimwa (x2), Wowe wadukunze,
Niyo mpamvu twakwizeye Mwami.
2. Ntacyo wahishe Umugeni wawe,
Wamuhishuriye Ubwiru bwawe,
Gucungurwa kuratwegereye,
Niyo mpamvu dutegereje izamurwa.

title: UMWAMI YESU YARAMBAGIJE
lyrics:
67. UMWAMI YESU YARAMBAGIJE
1. Umwami Yesu yarambagije Umugeni we muri isi,
Uwo Mugeni ni wowe nanjye,
Kuko twizeye Ubutumwa bw'igihe.
R/ Azamwishyira dafite ikizinga,
Umunkanyari cyangwa ikibi cyose,
Ahanagurwe amarira ku maso,
Maze yicare n'Umwami w'Abami.
2. Umwami yaje muri isi azanye inkwano y'igiciro cyinshi,
Iyo nkwano n'Amaraso ye n'Ijambo rye ryeza Umugeni.
3. Uwo Mugeni ni Itorero rye,
Rirategurwa ryezwa n'Ijambo rye,
Umwenda wera w'uwo Mugeni,
Ni imirimo yo gukiranuka y'abera.
4. Umwanya muto tuzashyingirwa,
Ubwo Umwami Yesu azaba agarutse,
Azarangurura ijwi ku ibicu,
Rizumywa gusa na uwo Mugeni.

title: HARIHO IBIHE BIRINDWI
lyrics:
68. HARIHO IBIHE BIRINDWI
1. Hari ibihe birindwi by'Amatorero,
Umukwe azaza kurebamo Umugeni we,
Azaza afite ubwiza bw'agatangaza,
Azasanganirwa n'uwameshe ikanzu ye.
R/Itegure Mugeni, usanganire Umukwe,
Kuko yatumye integuza ngo udatungurwa,
Araje bidatinze nk'uko yabivuze,
Isezerano rye ngo arisohoze.
2. Ibuka ko wogejwe mu Maraso ya Yesu,
Yagukoye agukunda ngo muzibanire,
Nawe komeza utwaze utamutenguha,
Ikamba wateguriwe rigahabwa undi.
3. Yewe Lawodokiya, ni wowe ubwirwa ubu,
Ko udashyushye udakonje, uri akazuyazi ubu,
Ese witeguye yuko ugiye kurukwa?
Wakwihannye ibyaha byawe, ukababarirwa?
4. Habayeho Umugabo witwaga Sawuli,
Uwavugaga Yesu ntabwo yamwumvaga,
Akibwira yuko arusha Yesu amaboko,
Agoswe n'inkingi y'Umuriro amuhamya ubwo.

title: KUGARUKA K'UMWAMI
lyrics:
69. KUGARUKA K'UMWAMI
1. Kugaruka k'Umwami kuregereje,
Abamwizeye twese tuzamurwe,
Tubone Umukiza wo twiringiye.
R/Nyobora Yesu unyobore,
Uzasange niteguye by'ukuri,
Kuko ari ahera hatazaba handuye.
2. Abizeye Ubutumwa bw'umugoroba,
Tumutegerezanije ibyiringiro byinshi,
Kuko twamaze kubona integuza ye.
3. Iherezo rya byose riri bugufi,
Buri nyubako yose igapimwa,
Mbese wahishuriwe ukuboko k'Umwami?
4. Mugenzi wanjye utarizera Yesu,
Umva Ubutumwa bwiza bw'Agakiza,
Va mu byaha umwiyegurire, aguhe ubugingo.

title: FATA UKUBOKO KW'IMANA
lyrics:
70. FATA UKUBOKO KW'IMANA
1. Ibihe birahinduka, nta cyo ku isi gihoraho,
Twiringire ibyo mu Iteka,
Fata Ukuboko kw'Imana.
R/Fata Ukuboko kw'Imana (x2),
Twiringire ibyo mu Iteka,
Fata Ukuboko kw'Imana.
2. Iringire Uwiteka, n'ubwo imyaka yazana iki,
N'ubwo inshuti zigutaye,
Mwihambireho iteka.
3. Nturarikire ubutunzi bubi, bubora bugashonga,
Shaka ubutunzi bwo mu Ijuru butazashira na mba.
4. Nurangiza urugendo, ni uba wizera Imana,
Uzazamurwa mu Bwiza, uzahasanga inzu nziza.

title: INSHUTI YA YESU
lyrics:
71. INSHUTI YA YESU
1. Nshuti ya Yesu ndanezerewe,
Nk'umunyabyaha nkanjye,
Guhorana inshuti nka Yesu,
Inyobora mu Ijuru.
R/Nshuti ya Yesu, ubusabane bwiza (x2),
Mbega ubusabane bwiza,
Yesu ni inshuti yanjye.
2. Inshuti igihe izindi shuti zose,
Zindetse zimpemukiye,
Nshuti impa ibyishimo n'amahoro,
Nshuti igihe umwanzi aje.
3. Inshuti inkiza uburwayi bwanjye,
N'iyo urupfu rwegereje,
Inshuti iyo ngeze ahakomeye,
Iramfata ikampa imbaraga.

title: TURI MU ISHUNGURWA
lyrics:
72. TURI MU ISHUNGURWA
R/Turi mu ishungurwa, turi mu ishungurwa,
Mugeni wa Yesu nawe cunga izamu ryawe,
Hagarara wemye, kandi kenyera gitware,
Guma mu birindiro byawe, dore Umukwe araje.
1. Abana b'Imana dore ibyorezo biraje,
Ntimugire ubwoba, ibyo byarahanuwe,
Intambara n'ibihuha, n'imitingito y'isi,
Ntibibakure umutima kuko ni igihe cyabyo.
2. Turi mu ishungurwa, turi mu ishungurwa,
Mugeni wa Yesu nawe ugume kurugamba,
Amasengesho atyaye niyo anesha satani,
Guma mu birindiro, dore Umukwe araje.
3. Mugeni wa Yesu muri isi siho iwacu,
Tuyibemo nk'abagenzi, biteguye gutaha,
Imirimo wayikozemo niyo mperekeza yawe,
Guma mu birindiro, dore Umukwe araje.
4. Turi mu ishungurwa, turi mu ishungurwa,
Mugeni wa Yesu, isi ntiguhende ubwenge,
Ngo iguteshe agaciro, ngo igusubize mu byaha,
Guma mu birindiro, dore Umukwe araje.
5. Turi mu ishungurwa, turi mu ishungurwa,
Mugeni wa Yesu zirikana Ubuhanuzi,
Dore ibyahanuwe byose bisohoye,
Mubireba, guma mu birindiro, dore Umukwe araje.

title: BOSE MU CYUMBA CYO HEJURU
lyrics:
73. BOSE MU CYUMBA CYO HEJURU
1. Bose mu cyumba cyo hejuru bari bahuje umutima,
Ubwo Umwuka Wera wamanutse,
Nk'uko Umwami yabisezeranye.
R/Mwami ohereza imbaraga zawe (x3),
Maze utubatize twese.
2. Imbaraga z'Ijuru zimanutse,
Ni ijwi ry'umuriri,
Indimi z'umuriro zibazaho,
Nk'uko Umwami yabisezeranye.
3. Izo mbaraga za kera zahawe,
Ba Data bakiranukiye Imana,
Zasezeranijwe abizera,
Twabasha kuzihabwa.

title: BYOSE NDABIKWEGURIYE
lyrics:
74. BYOSE NDABIKWEGURIYE
1. Numvise yuko isi izashira,
N'uyu mubiri nambaye ugashira,
Namenye ko kandi hari indi ngoma,
Yateguriwe Umugeni wa Kristo.
R/Byose ndabikweguriye Mwami,
Byose ndabikweguriye,
Ntabwo nagundira isi izashira,
Ngo nyisimbure ingoma itazashira.
2. Nashakanye n'isi nihuza nayo,
Ntaramenya Uwancunguje Amaraso,
None ibyaha byanjye ndabyihanye ubu,
Ndaje Mwami Yesu unyibohorere.
3. Nubwo mu isi mbona ndi mu ntambara,
Satani anshoza ibyo ntagambiriye,
Nzi yuko Mukiza wanesheje,
Kubwo ubuntu bwawe waranshunguye.
4. Ubwo wampamagaye ndemerewe,
Ukampa isabato yo mu mutima,
Naho ubu kwizera kwageragezwa,
Niringiye yuko uzaneshereza.
5. Noneho Mukiza ndakwihereje,
Urukundo rwawe nirunyobore,
Ningera aho inzira irangirira,
Nzaguhimbazanye n'abakijijwe.

title: HAGIYE KUBAHO UMUNSI MUKURU
lyrics:
75. HAGIYE KUBAHO UMUNSI MUKURU
1. Hagiye kubaho umunsi mukuru,
Umunsi w'ibirori by'Umukiza,
Ubwo azaza kujyana Umugeni we,
Yasize asabye muri isi.
R/Yasize akoye asubira mu Ijuru,
Ategereje igihe cy'ishyingirwa,
None dore nacyo kiri bugufi,
Mbese Mugenzi uriteguye?
2. Umugeni wakowe ni Itorero,
Inkwano ya Yesu ni Amaraso ye,
Yamennye mu gihe yazaga muri isi,
Ubwo yari ku Musaraba.
3. Umukwe wacu ntiyarobanuye,
Yaba umuzungu cyangwa umwirabura,
Umukire, umukene,
Abamwizeye twese tuzaba Umugeni we.
4. Yohereje Umuranga Branham,
Ngo abwire Umugeni imico y'Umukwe,
Ngo ahishure n'ubwiru bw'Ibyanditswe,
Kugirango Umugeni ashyike.
5. Yesu arahamagara ari mu bicu,
Twebwe abizeye tumusanganire,
Atujyane aho yaduteguriye,
Tuzahorana umunezero.

title: UHORAHO
lyrics:
76. UHORAHO
1. Uhoraho Mana ntangazwa cyane,
N'ibyaremwe n'ibigiganza byawe,
Inyenyeri no guhinda kw'inkuba,
Byerekana ububasha bwawe.
R/Mwami Mana ndakuririmbira,
Uri nkuru, uri nkuru,
Mwami Mana ndakuririmbira,
Uri nkuru, uri nkuru.
2. Iyo nibutse Mana ko watanze Umwana wawe ku Musaraba,
Imitwaro yanjye akayikorera,
Yamfiriye ngo nkurweho ibyaha.
3. Kristo azaza azanye n'ingabo ze,
Azanjyana mu rugo rwa Data,
Nzapfukama mpimbaze Imana yanjye,
Nzaririmba nti "Mana uri nkuru."

title: NDAMUKUNDA YESU
lyrics:
77. NDAMUKUNDA YESU
1. Nari narazimiye nk'intama mu gihuru,
Maze Yesu arancyura,
Ambabarira ibyaha anyogesha Amaraso,
Nguwe neza kwa Data.
R/Ndamukunda, ndamukunda Yesu,
Kuko yabanje kunkunda,
Akambonera agakiza kanjye i Kaluvari ku giti.
2. Narindi ahatabona, nizera ibyo mu rujijo,
Yohereza Ubutumwa,
Arabuhamiriza n'Inkingi y'Umuriro,
Ngo buze bumbature.
3. None umutima wanjye wuzuye umunezero,
Sinkiri uko narindi,
Ubu nanjye nahamya Yesu mwiza namenye,
Yihishuye mu Ijambo.
4. Nshuti dufatanije kuyoborwa n'Umucyo,
Icyo nimushire amanga,
Mubwire abantu Ijambo, babohorwe izo ngoyi,
Baboshywe na satani.
5. Dusohoke mu isi, ubwo tuzibanire iteka,
Nimuze turusheho kwegerana na Data,
Nk'Umukwe n'Umugeni,
Vuba tuzumva ijwi rye.

title: GARUKA MWAMI
lyrics:
VIII. IZAMURWA RY'UMUGENI WA KRISTO
78. GARUKA MWAMI
1. Habwa ikuzo Mucunguzi,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Wowe wadukunze kera,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
R/Ngwino Mwami kubana bawe,
Tugutegerezanye imitima imenetse,
Isi igeze ku iherezo,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
2. Wowe wasize ingoma yawe,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Wigize umuntu udukize,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
3. Waducunguje Amaraso,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Warabambwe turabamburwa,
Ngwino turagutegereje.
4. Turi ku iherezo Mwami,
Ngwino turagutegereje,
Turaguhimbaza Mwami,
Ngwino turagutegereje.

title: GARE RYANJYE
lyrics:
79. GARE RYANJYE
1. Njye narebye kure hakurya y'uruzi,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze,
Nkikijwe n'Ingabo z'Abamarayika,
Zije kunjyana aho nahoze.
R/Manuka, Gare ryanjye,
Uze kunjyana aho nahoze,
Ngwino Gare ryanjye,
Uze kunjyana aho nahoze.
2. Nuntanga kwinjira njye ntaragerayo,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze,
Bwira Bene Data ko ndi mu nzira,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze.
3. Nuntanga kwinjira njye ntaragerayo,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze,
Bwira Bene Data batabarutse,
Ndi mu nzira bantegereze.
4. Nuntanga kwinjira njye ntaragerayo,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze,
Bwira Frere Branham ko ndi mu nzira,
Baza kunjyana aho nahoze.

title: AHANTU H'UBWISHINGIZI
lyrics:
80. AHANTU H'UBWISHINGIZI
1. Ahantu h'ubwishingizi hategurwa n'Umwami,
Aho Umugeni aruhukiye,
Yambaye impeta y'Umukwe.
R/Aho hakurya y'uruzi,
Ahaba umucyo gusa,
Huzuyeyo umunezero,
N'indirimbo zo kunesha.
2. Niturangiza urugamba turwana na satani,
Tuzahora turirimba mu mudugudu uhoraho.
3. Ubwo inzogera izavuga na ya nkuge y'i Siyoni,
Umuyaga w'amahoro uzahagurutse inkuge.
4. Imyaka ibihumbi bibiri dutegereje impanda,
Nibwo Umugeni azajyanwa, maze ubukwe butangire.

title: HARI UMURWA
lyrics:
81. HARI UMURWA
1. Hari Umurwa wateguriwe abizeye Izina rya Yesu,
N'abatoranijwe n'Ijambo kubwa Marayika wa Karindwi.
R/Ni Umurwa wera, ntuzinjirwamo n'abanduye,
Abadakizwa kubwo iri Jambo ntibazajya muri uwo Murwa.
2. Uwo murwa wateguriwe abikorera Umusaraba,
N'abasize ibyabo byose bagakurikira iyi Nzira.
3. Wahamagawe, wumvire ijwi rye rikubwira ngo "ngwino uhunge,"
None se ko ubu usubiye inyuma kandi wari ufite ubugingo?
4. Yewe nshuti z'Umusaraba, mukomeze imbere ni ahera,
Tuzaruhuka, tuzanezerwa nitugera imbere y'Umwami.

title: HARI IGIHUGU
lyrics:
82. HARI IGIHUGU
1. Hari igihugu kure y'inyenyeri,
Hariyo umurwa utabamo ijoro,
Nidukiranuka tuzagerayo,
Aho Umwana w'Intama ari urumuri.
R/Uwo murwa umurikirwa na Yesu,
Uwo murwa utageramo ijoro,
Mfiteyo ingoro nziza, nzaruhuka imiruho,
Nzigira ahamurikirwa na Yesu.
2. Nubwo tumurikirwa ariko tuziko,
Iri zuba ritumurikira ubu,
Rizahinduka ibicu nitugera,
Aho Umwana w'Intama ari urumuri.
3. Aho hari ubusitani bw'iteka,
Nta joro, hari amanywa y'iteka ryose,
Tuzahanagurwa amarira yose,
Aho Umwana w'Intama ari urumuri.
4. Aha ku isi hari ibiduca intege,
Ukwizera kwacu kugahangana nabyo,
Turarira ariko tuzanezerwa,
Aho Umwana w'Intama amurika.
5. Izuba rijimye cyangwa habe ijoro,
Nta bwoba nta rwijiji mfite muri njye,
Nzi yuko mu Ijuru mpafite inzu nshya,
Aho Umwana w'Imana ari urumuri.

title: NDIRIMBIRA MU NZIRA
lyrics:
83. NDIRIMBIRA MU NZIRA
1. Ndirimbira mu nzira iyobora imitima,
I Kaluvari hatemba isoko inesha,
N'aho imyambi yandasa, Umwami arabizi,
Ni nawe unyobora nkamukurikira.
R/Nifuza kumureba amaso mu yandi,
Ngo ndirimbe iteka ubuntu bwe bwinshi,
Mu mihanda y'izahabu ndangurura ijwi,
Amaganya arashize, ndi mu Bwugamo.
2. Iyo amazi asuma ajya muhengeri,
Umukiza afata ingabo yo mu Ijuru,
Wenyine azanyobora no muri isi,
Bidatinze ariko nzagera mu Ijuru.
3. Mu murimo wa Data naho ijoro ryagwa,
Umwijima ukambuza kumenya inzira,
Ni we unyiyegereza, akamurikira,
Anyongera imbaraga, akanyobora.
4. Mu mibande ikomeye ndeba imisozi,
Binyibutsa na none Umwami w'ishema,
Yitwaje inkota ityaye ngo ayobore urugamba,
Ni nawe unyobora abisingirizwe.

title: NDI UMUGENZI N'UMWIMUKIRA
lyrics:
84. NDI UMUGENZI N'UMWIMUKIRA
1. Ndi umugenzi n'umwimukira,
Ngenda mu isi y'ibyaha,
Mu nzira ngana mu murwa,
Ubwo abera bazinjira.
R/Igihe Abera, Abera nibinjira,
Mwami nshaka kuba muri bo,
Abera nibinjira.
2. Nziko nzabona Umukiza,
Ubwo nzaba mbohowe,
Imiryango y'Ijuru ikingurwe,
Ubwo abera bazinjira.
3. Tuzengurutse ya ntebe,
Imiryango izakingwa,
Nzahimbaza nti "Shimwa, Shimwa,"
Ubwo abera banzinjira.
4. Ntegereje igare rizamanuka,
Kunjyana mu Bwami,
Nzarenga ibicu njya mu Ijuru,
Ubwo abera bazinjira.

title: TURI MU RUGENDO
lyrics:
85. TURI MU RUGENDO
1. Turi mu rugendo, turi mu rugendo,
Twumvire Data dukomeze inzira,
Twavuye mu byaha twamenye Ijambo,
Uzaryizera wese azahoraho.
R/Bana b'Imana turi mu rugendo,
Mumenye neza ko tugiye gushyika,
Njye ndahareba, njye ndahakunda,
Nzashima Yesu nitugerayo.
2. Abanyamadini bibeshya yuko,
Abana b'Imana ngo twe twarayobye,
Ntabwo twayobye, aho yujya turahazi,
Kuko na kera twebwe twahozeyo.
3. Yewe Mugenzi komeza urugendo,
Wireba inyuma komeza inzira,
Inzira y'Imana irafunganye,
Uwayigenze ntajarajara.

title: I BURENGERAZUBA
lyrics:
86. I BURENGERAZUBA
1. Iburengerazuba rirarenze,
Rigeze ku iherezo ryaryo,
Ndabona igihe cyegereje,
Ni igihe cyo kurenga kw'izuba.
R/Ni iherezo (x2),
Ni iherezo ry'urugendo,
Ni iherezo (x2),
Ni iherezo rya byose.
2. Reba umucyo wa nimugoroba,
Iburengerazuba wandasive,
Ugaragaze Umwana w'umuntu,
Ndabyizeye, nibyo ndabyizeye.
3. Mugenzi tugeze ku iherezo,
Tuneshe isi maze twitahire,
Mugabo mbese ni gihe ki?
Tuneshe isi tubone kugenda.

title: IY'ISI SI IWACU
lyrics:
87. IY'ISI SI IWACU
1. Iyi si iwacu, twebwe turi abagenzi,
Twibikiye ubutunzi iwacu mu Ijuru,
Mpamagawe n'Abamarayika mu Ijuru,
Siniyumva ndi iwacu hano mu isi.
R/Mukiza urabizi, nta nshuti ngira nkawe,
Niba Ijuru atari iryanjye se ngire nte?
Mpamagawe n'Abamarayika mu Ijuru,
Siniyumva nk'iwacu hano mu isi.
2. Nzi yuko ntegerejwe n'abera mu Ijuru,
Byose nabitunganije hamwe na Yesu,
Ampa imbaraga iyo ncitse intege Mwami,
Siniyumva nk'iwacu hano mu isi.
3. Mu gihugu cy'Ubwiza tuzabayo iteka,
Impande zose abera bose baririmba,
Indirimbo "shimwe," aho iwacu mu Ijuru,
Siniyumva nk'iwacu hano mu isi.

title: NYUMA TUZASOBANUKIRWA
lyrics:
88. NYUMA TUZASOBANUKIRWA
1. Tugeragejwe turibaza,
Kuki duhora tugeragezwa,
Kandi tubona abanyabyaha,
Mu bibi byabo badahanwa.
R/Hariho igihe tuzamenya,
Tumenye impamvu y'ibyo byose,
Wihangane ugume mu mucyo,
Vuba tuzasobanukirwa.
2. Urupfu rutwara abo dukunda,
Tugasigara mu bwigunge,
Tukibaza kuki abagome,
Batunga bagatunganirwa.
3. Dukiranuke kugeza gupfa,
Imiruho igeze ku iherezo,
Imibabaro izibagirana,
Nitugera ku irembo ryiza.
4. Tubonye Yesu ava mu bwiza,
Ankuruye inzu yo mu Ijuru,
Tuzamusanganira mu bicu,
Vuba tuzasobanukirwa.

title: NTA GUSAZA
lyrics:
89. NTA GUSAZA
1. Numvise inkuru z'igihugu cya kure,
N'ubuturo bwiza bw'ubugingo,
Bwubatswe na Yesu aho ntituzapfa,
Aho ntituzongera gusaza.
R/Nta gusaza (x2),
Aho ntituzongera gusaza,
Nta gusaza (x2),
Aho ntituzongera gusaza.
2. Muri uwo Murwa mwiza ntituzarindagira,
Vuba tuzibera mu munezero,
Tuzashima Umwami mu bihe bidashira,
Muri icyo gihugu nta gupfa.
3. Umurimo urangiye, tuzambikwa ikamba,
Ingorane n'ibigeragezo, n'amakuba bishize,
Tuzahuza amajwi n'aya Bene Data batashye.

title: MBEGA UMUNSI
lyrics:
90. MBEGA UMUNSI
1. Hari umunsi wegereje, aho tutazababara,
Ntabwo hazabudika, nta marira azabayo,
Bizaba ari amahoro muri uwo Murwa Wera,
Mbega uko uzaba umeze.
R/Mbega umunsi mwiza,
Ubwo nzabona Yesu mbone mu maso,
Wancunguye kubw'ubuntu bwe,
Yamfashe ikiganza, angeza muri icyo gihugu,
Mbega umunsi uko uzaba umeze.
2. Ntabwo tuzababara, tuzatura imitwaro,
Nta gutandukana, nta burwayi bubayo,
Nzibanira iteka na Yesu wamfiriye,
Mbega umunsi uko uzaba umeze.

title: NZIGURUKIRA
lyrics:
91. NZIGURUKIRA
1. Mu gitondo byose birangiye,
Nzigurukira,
I muhira aho Yesu atuye,
Nzigurukira.
R/Nzigurukira, mbega ubwiza,
Nzigurukira,
Ku iherezo byose birangiye,
Nzigurukira.
2. Hasigaye umwanya muto cyane,
Nzigurukira,
Mu gihugu cy'Umunezero,
Nzigurukira.
3. Ubuzima bw'isi burangiye,
Nzigurukira,
Nk'inyoni ivuye mu mutego,
Nzigurukira.

title: UMURWA W'UMUCYO
lyrics:
92. UMURWA W'UMUCYO
1. Umurwa wuzuye umucyo,
Uri hejuru ya byose,
Nta muntu wo muri isi,
Wareba ubwiza bwawo.
R/Hamurikirwa n'Imana,
Hazaba Umwana w'Intama,
Muri icyo gihugu cyiza,
I Yerusalemu nshya.
2. Niho ubwiza bwinshi buri,
Hari igiti cy'ubugingo,
Hari uruzi rw'ubugingo,
Niho baruhukira.
3. Iyo abagenzi bagezeyo,
Bananijwe n'ubutayu,
Ku masoko y'ubugingo,
Niho baruhukira.
4. Mbega umunezero ku isi,
Ubwo Yesu azaba ahari,
Mu murwa wuzuye umucyo,
Uzahoraho iteka.

title: YELUSALEMU NSHYA
lyrics:
93. YELUSALEMU NSHYA
R/Yewe Yelusaremu nshya, yewe Yerusalemu nshya,
Izamurwa ryacu rirasohoye, tugiye kugutambagira.
1. Yewe Yelusaremu nshya, rwa rurembo ruva mu Ijuru ni ukuri,
Umugeni ararimbishijwe, agiye kugutambagira.
2. Ibimenyetso byose birasohoye,
Umukwe nguriya ahagaze ku rugi,
Tumurinde, tujaragire, tucane amatabaza,
Maze usanganire Umukwe.
3. Ni ukuri ururembo ruramanutse,
Yelusaremu nshya ivuye mu Ijuru ni ukuri,
Umugeni arazamuwe, agiye gusanganira Umukwe we.
4. Nshuti zamadini nimuyiyame, mukurikire Ijambo,
Aribwo buzima bushya,
Muyoborwe n'Umwuka, mugendere mu mucyo,
Niho urwo rurembo muzarutahamo.
5. Hanze hazaba imbwa n'abarozi, abajura, abasinzi n'abasambanyi,
N'izindi nkozi z'ibibi zikunda umwijima,
N'abagoreka Ijambo bakurikiye indamu.

title: HAKURYA Y'URUSIKA
lyrics:
94. HAKURYA Y'URUSIKA
1. Hakurya y'urusika rw'ibihe,
Abariyo ubu baranezerewe,
Kuko batsinze urugamba rwo kuri isi,
Natwe twiseguye, Yesu azabidufasha.
R/Wowe ihane twigire hakurya,
Dusige imuruho y'isi na satani,
Ntituzongera kurira no kwifuza,
Tuzaba mu mahoro adashira.
2. Na Branham atarajya hakurya,
Imana yamweretse mu iyerekwa,
Ntiyifuzaga kugaruka ino ku isi,
Ibyo byamuteye ishyaka ryo kujyayo.
3. Branham amaze kuva mu iyerekwa,
Yongeye imbaraga mu byiza yakoraga,
Ubu yibereye hakurya y'urusika,
Yambaye Theofanie, ubu arategereje.
4. Hakurya hariyo ba sogokuruza,
Barishimye kuko bakoreye Ijuru,
Barihamwe biteguye kujya iwacu,
Tuzabana nabo ibihe bidashira.

title: AMAKURU YO MU IJURU
lyrics:
95. AMAKURU YO MU IJURU
1. Njya numva amakuru yo mu Ijuru,
Uko abakiranutsi bazahembwa,
Ndabyumva urukumbuzi rukandenga,
Mfite amatsiko yo kuzabibona.
R/Yewe wa si we nzakuvaho,
Mubiri nawe nzakwiyambura,
Satani nzamwishima hejuru.
2. Umukwe azarimbisha Umugeni,
Umubiri w'ubwiza bwo mu Ijuru,
Umubiri mwiza urabagirana,
Nawe ndakwifuriza kuzabibona.
3. Imyaka igihumbi tuzayimara,
Tunezerewe umunezero udashira,
Dutaramanye n'Abamarayika,
Twishimiye ko twatsinze urugamba.
4. Tuzaba turi ishema rya Branham,
Atwerekana imbere y'Uwamutumye,
Ati "ngaba abemeye ubutumwa bwiza,"
Ese nawe ufite abo uzerekana?

title: MBARIZA UMUGENI
lyrics:
96. MBARIZA UMUGENI
1. Hakurya y'urusika rw'ibihe,
Abariyo baranezerewe,
Branham yarababonye ubwo yari mu iyerekwa,
Yumva ashatse kwigumirayo.
R/Mbariza Umugeni wa Yesu,
Uti "mbese uracyasenga?
Amatabaza yawe araka?
Igare ryawe rije ubu?
Mbese ubwo waba witeguye?"
2. Pawulo yavugije impanda,
Bagenzi be bavuza impanda,
Branham nawe araza,
Arimo aravuza impanda,
Uwinjira niyinjire ubu.
3. Wowe wumvise ubu butumwa,
Ntiwinangire umutima,
Dore Yesu arakomanga,
Ashaka ku kubohora,
Nukingura iwawe arinjira.
4. Nshuti mbega umunezero,
Hirya y'urusika rw'ibihe,
Kubazaba bagezeyo,
Tuzambikwa indi mibiri,
Y'ubwiza tugeze mu Ijuru.

title: ISEZERANO RISHYA
lyrics:
97. ISEZERANO RISHYA
1. Isezerano rishya rirashyitse,
Igihe cy'abanyamahanga kigiye gushira,
Icyo dutegereje nk'Umugeni,
Ni isezerano ryo kuzamurwa.
R/Kwizera kwacu kuzarenga ibicu,
N'imibiri yacu izahindurwa,
Tuzatumbagira mu bicu,
Dusanganire Umwami wacu.
2. Ibuye ritwikira nirimanuka,
Abera bose bazagaragazwa,
Itorero rigere kugushyika,
Ubwo piramide izazamurwa.
3. Abera basinziriye bakangurwe,
N'imibiri y'abariho ihindurwe,
Impanda y'Imana izavuga,
Tujye mu bukwe bw'Umwana w'Intama.
4. Abakurikiye ijwi rya Pawulo, Irene,
Maritini, Kolomba, rya Luteri, Wesireyi,
Na Branham uwo munsi nukuri tuzamubona.
5. Nyuma y'imibabaro y'umubiri,
Mugenzi twateguriwe ibyicaro,
Kubw'umunezero w'Umukwe n'Umugeni,
Hazinjirayo urukundo rushyitse.

title: UMUTIMA WANJYE URERA
lyrics:
98. UMUTIMA WANJYE URERA
1. Umutima wanjye urera,
Nk'urubura, nk'uburabyo,
Kandi wera nk'amasoko,
Kandi woroshye nk'inyoni,
Urera nta mwanda,
Nshaka kuguruka nk'Abamarayika,
Mu kirere cyiza (x2).
2. Umutima wanjye wuzuye,
Ibyishimo byinshi cyane (x2),
Urejejwe, urera,
Nshaka kwigendera nk'Umwami wanjye we,
Iyo azaba nanjye mbeyo (x2).
3. Ijambo rye nibyo kurya,
By'ubugingo byinshi cyane (x2),
Dore inyota n'inzara,
Ijambo ry'Imana rihishwe muri We,
Tumusabe ariduhe (x2).
4. Muvandimwe wumva Ijambo rye,
Uryakire uko riri,
Igihe ni gito ijwi nirivuga,
Imbabazi zishize, nta kundi kwihana.

title: NARI MURI WE
lyrics:
99. NARI MURI WE
1. Mbere y'itangiriro ubwo yari Elohim,
Njyewe nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri Yesu,
None ubu naragaragajwe.
2. Igihe yasuraga Aburahamu mu mubiri,
Njyewe nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
3. Igihe yamanukaga mu itanura ry'umuriro,
Niyewe nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
4. Igihe yagendagendaga mu nzira z'i Yerusalemu,
Nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
5. Igihe bamuciraga urubanza rwo kumwica,
Nanjye nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
6. Igihe bamubambye urya munsi i Kaluvari,
Nanjye nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
7. Igihe yamaze iminsi itatu ikuzimu,
Njyewe nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
8. Igihe yazukaga ku munsi wa mbere w'icyumweru,
Niyewe nari muri We,
Nari muri We, nari muri We,
Nari muri Yesu, none ubu naragaragajwe.
